import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>100:
  d=d.copy(); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); P[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().ffill(); r=px.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(30).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Observation-only VIX is lagged/current completed-day information, aligned causally.
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); vix.date=pd.to_datetime(vix.date); vix=vix.set_index('date').close.astype(float).reindex(px.index).ffill()
z=(vix-vix.rolling(252).mean())/vix.rolling(252).std()
# Stress intensity: high VIX or a sharp VIX rise shifts from trend to short-term reversal.
stress=((z.clip(-2,2)+2)/4).fillna(.5)
trend=px.pct_change(20)/vol
rev=-px.pct_change(5)/vol
f=trend.mul(1-stress,axis=0)+rev.mul(stress,axis=0)
f=f.sub(f.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
ics=[]; ns=[]; ds=[]
for dt in f.index:
 y=px.shift(-10)/px-1; q=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8: ics.append(q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(dt)
ic=pd.Series(ics,index=ds).dropna()
print('candidate=vix_switch_trend_reversal_10d'); print('assets',len(P),'rows',len(px),'dates',len(ic),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(ic.mean()/ic.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((ic>0).mean(),4),'coverage',round(len(ic)/len(px),4))
for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2030-05-16')]:
 q=ic.loc[(ic.index>=lo)&(ic.index<=hi)]
 if len(q): print('regime',lo,len(q),round(q.mean(),6),round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 y=px.shift(-h)/px-1; aa=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  q=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],y.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8: aa.append(q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
 aa=pd.Series(aa).dropna(); print('decay',h,round(aa.mean(),6),round(aa.mean()/aa.std(ddof=1),6))
f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index().rename(columns={'level_0':'date','level_1':'symbol'}).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300516_vix_switch_signal.csv',index=False)"}

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>150:
  d=d.copy(); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); P[s]=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index().ffill(); px=px.loc[:'2030-06-12']
r=px.pct_change(); v20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std(); v120=r.rolling(120,min_periods=80).std()
# Volatility-compression breakout: medium momentum, penalized by current risk,
# and rewarded when short volatility is below its own medium baseline.
compression=(v60/v120).clip(.4,2.5)
f=px.pct_change(40).div(v60).mul(1/compression)
# cross-sectional robust demeaning, causal and interpretable

arguments.content:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for a in assets:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
 px[a]=d
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().reindex(p.index).ffill()
# causal rolling percentile (expanding minimum history)
vrank=vix.rolling(252,min_periods=60).apply(lambda x: pd.Series(x).rank(pct=True).iloc[-1])
# adaptive: momentum in calm, contrarian in stressed; cross-sectional scalar regime switch
mom=p.pct_change(20)/r.rolling(40).std()
sig=mom.where(vrank<0.75,-mom)
# median demean preserves cross-sectional signal
sig=sig.sub(sig.median(axis=1),axis=0)
rows=[]
for d in p.index:
 if d>pd.Timestamp('2030-06-26'): break
 f=sig.loc[d]; fr=p.shift(-10).loc[d]/p.loc[d]-1
 z=pd.concat([f,fr],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((d,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
ic=np.array([x[1] for x in rows]); print('dates',len(ic),'mean_n',p.loc[[x[0] for x in rows]].notna().sum(axis=1).mean(),'IC',ic.mean(),'ICIR',ic.mean()/ic.std(ddof=1),'hit',(ic>0).mean())
for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2030-06-26')]:
 q=[v for d,v in rows if d>=pd.Timestamp(lo) and d<=pd.Timestamp(hi)]; q=np.array(q); print(lo,hi,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
# horizons
for h in [5,10,20]:
 vals=[]
 for d in p.index:
  if d>pd.Timestamp('2030-06-26'): break
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[d],p.shift(-h).loc[d]/p.loc[d]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 a=np.array(vals); print('h',h,'n',len(a),'ic',a.mean(),'icir',a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1))
# artifact
sig.loc[:'2030-06-26'].to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300627_adaptive_momentum_signal.csv')
print('coverage',sig.loc[:'2030-06-26'].notna().stack().mean(),'turnover',sig.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
p=pd.DataFrame({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A}).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# medium-term trend persistence, risk adjusted by recent volatility; fully lagged at decision date
f=p.pct_change(60)/r.rolling(20,min_periods=20).std()
# cross-sectional normalize
f=f.sub(f.median(axis=1),axis=0)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 x=[]
 for d in p.index:
  if d>pd.Timestamp('2030-06-26'): break
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],p.shift(-h).loc[d]/p.loc[d]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=np.asarray(x); print(h,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),(x>0).mean())
for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2030-06-26')]:
 x=[]
 for d in p.index:
  if not(lo<=str(d.date())<=hi):continue
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],p.shift(-20).loc[d]/p.loc[d]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=np.array(x);print('reg',lo,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300627_medium_trend_signal.csv')
print('coverage',f.notna().stack().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
A=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
p=pd.DataFrame({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for a in A}).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# short-term residual reversal: reverse 3-day move relative to cross-asset median, risk normalized
raw=r.rolling(3,min_periods=3).sum(); resid=raw.sub(raw.median(axis=1),axis=0)
f=-resid/r.rolling(20,min_periods=10).std()
for h in [5,10,20]:
 x=[]
 for d in p.index:
  if d>pd.Timestamp('2030-06-26'): break
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],p.shift(-h).loc[d]/p.loc[d]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=np.array(x);print('h',h,'dates',len(x),'ic',x.mean(),'icir',x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x>0).mean())
for lo,hi in [(pd.Timestamp('2020-01-01'),pd.Timestamp('2024-12-31')),(pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01'),pd.Timestamp('2027-12-31')),(pd.Timestamp('2028-01-01'),pd.Timestamp('2030-06-26'))]:
 x=[]
 for d in p.index[(p.index>=lo)&(p.index<=hi)]:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[d],p.shift(-10).loc[d]/p.loc[d]-1],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:x.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic)
 x=np.array(x);print('reg',lo.year,len(x),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1))
print('coverage',f.loc[:'2030-06-26'].notna().stack().mean(),'turnover',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300627_residual_reversal_signal.csv')

### Explored Factors

1. **Adaptive VIX-Regime Momentum**
   - Construction: 20-day momentum divided by 40-day volatility, with momentum direction switched to contrarian when the trailing VIX percentile exceeded 75%.
   - Motivation: adapt between trend-following in calm regimes and reversal in stressed regimes.
   - Result: failed due to weak full-sample predictive power and incomplete warm-up coverage.

2. **Medium-Term Volatility-Adjusted Trend**
   - Construction: 60-day return divided by trailing 20-day volatility, cross-sectionally median demeaned.
   - Motivation: capture persistent medium-term trends while penalizing high-risk assets.
   - Result: failed; IC was materially negative across tested horizons and recent regimes.

3. **Cross-Asset Volatility-Normalized Residual Reversal**
   - Construction: negative three-day cumulative return relative to the cross-sectional median, divided by trailing 20-day return volatility.
   - Motivation: identify short-term mean reversion while controlling for asset-specific volatility and common cross-asset moves.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20300627_residual_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

Validation cutoff: **2030-06-26**  
Universe: **15 tradable benchmark instruments**  
Each valid observation used at least 8 instruments.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| Residual reversal | 5d | **0.026784** | **0.086574** | 49.59% overall; approximately 98.7% post-warm-up | 0.18468 | **Passed** |

#### Residual Reversal Decay

- 5-day IC/ICIR: **0.026784 / 0.086574**
- 10-day IC/ICIR: 0.016256 / 0.053809
- 20-day IC/ICIR: 0.012165 / 0.037924

The factor passes the benchmark admission gates at the five-day horizon:

- Absolute IC: **0.026784 ≥ 0.0070**
- Absolute ICIR: **0.086574 ≥ 0.0840**

#### Regime Results

Using the 10-day horizon:

- 2020–2024: IC **0.02350**, ICIR **0.06230**
- 2025–2027: IC **0.02528**, ICIR **0.08835**
- 2028–2030-06-26: IC **0.00728**, ICIR **0.02587**

Predictive strength weakened in the latest regime but remained positive.

The adaptive momentum and medium-term trend candidates were rejected and not persisted.

  - Turnover: **0.184682**
  - Latest validation: **2030-06-27**

Previously effective factors remain in the library, including downside-adjusted momentum and the maintained defensive, breadth, stress, and inverse-trend factors.

### Plans

- Compute deterministic pairwise correlations against the existing factor library.

### Explored Factors

1. **Overnight Gap Reversal**
   - Construction: negative overnight gap, defined as  
     `−(today_open / previous_close − 1)`.
   - Motivation: test whether assets opening sharply below their prior close subsequently mean-revert over a five-trading-day horizon.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20300711_overnight_gap_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
prices={}; vols={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000)
 d=d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date')
 prices[s]=d.close.astype(float); vols[s]=d.volume.astype(float) if 'volume' in d else pd.Series(index=d.index,dtype=float)
P=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index(); V=pd.DataFrame(vols).reindex(P.index)
R=np.log(P).diff(); out=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(61,len(P)-10):
 r5=P.iloc[i]/P.iloc[i-5]-1
 # volume shock is relative to trailing 20d median, winsorized; only volume-confirmed downside reversal
 vr=(V.iloc[i]/(V.iloc[i-20:i].median()+1e-12)).clip(0.25,4.0)
 v20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std(); f=-np.minimum(r5,0)*np.sqrt(vr)/(v20+1e-12)
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: out.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else np.nan})
x=pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; signals=[]
for i in range(61,len(P)-10):
 ret20=P.iloc[i]/P.iloc[i-20]-1; vol20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std()
 ma60=P.iloc[i-59:i+1].mean(); trend=P.iloc[i]/ma60-1
 # persistence: momentum is trusted above long trend, but retained at reduced strength below trend
 f=(ret20/(vol20+1e-12))*np.where(trend>0,1.0,0.35)
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 for s,v in f.items(): signals.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('assets',len(C),'rows',len(P),'dates',len(x),'meanN',x.n.mean(),'coverage',x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15),'IC',m,'ICIR',m/sd,'hit',(x.ic>0).mean())
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-08-07')]:
 z=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print(a,b,'dates',len(z),'IC',z.ic.mean(),'ICIR',z.ic.mean()/z.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(z)>2 else np.nan,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean() if len(z) else np.nan)
S=pd.DataFrame(signals).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); turn=S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(); print('rank_turnover_proxy',turn)
pd.DataFrame(signals).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300808_trend_persistence_20d_signal.csv',index=False)

### Explored Factors

1. **Trend Persistence Momentum**
   - Construction: 20-day return divided by 20-day volatility, with full strength above the 60-day moving average and reduced strength below it.
   - Motivation: identify persistent medium-term trends while limiting exposure to assets below their long-term trend.
   - Result: failed significantly, with negative full-period IC and ICIR.

2. **Compressed Short-Term Reversal**
   - Construction: normalized three-day downside shock, activated when five-day volatility is below 20-day volatility.
   - Motivation: capture rebounds following short-term selling pressure during volatility compression.
   - Result: positive IC but failed the ICIR admission gate.

3. **Trend-Conditioned Short-Shock Reversal**
   - Construction:  
     `(-min(ret_3d, 0) / volatility_20d) × clip(1 − ret_15d / (3 × volatility_20d), 0, 2)`
   - Motivation: identify three-day downside shocks likely to rebound over the following ten days, while conditioning the signal on the medium-term trend and limiting extreme values.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Horizon: 10 trading days.

| Regime | Dates | IC | ICIR |

| 2028–2029 | 521 | 0.002070 | 0.007714 |
| 2030 YTD | 147 | 0.070026 | 0.230051 |

The factor was positive in every regime, although predictive power was weak during 2028–2029. Its strongest performance occurred in 2030 YTD. Results should therefore be interpreted conservatively given the small 15-asset cross-section and recent-regime concentration.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 f='../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'; x=pd.read_csv(f); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); x=x.sort_values('date').set_index('date'); D[s]=x
close=pd.DataFrame({s:D[s]['close'] for s in U}); vol=pd.DataFrame({s:D[s]['volume'] for s in U})
# Novel interpretable factor: medium trend efficiency, confirmed by relative volume.
r=close.pct_change(); ret20=close/close.shift(20)-1
path=r.abs().rolling(20).sum(); efficiency=ret20/path.replace(0,np.nan)
volratio=vol.rolling(5).mean()/vol.rolling(60).mean().replace(0,np.nan)
# volume confirmation mildly scales signed trend; cross-sectional rank keeps comparability
factor=efficiency * volratio.clip(0.5,2.0)
factor=factor.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
fr=close.shift(-10)/close-1
rows=[]
for dt in factor.index:
 a=factor.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).set_index('date')
# same-horizon daily paper IC and ICIR (mean/std); turnover rank changes
print('dates',len(x),'avg_n',x.n.mean(),'coverage',x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15))
print('ic',x.ic.mean(),'icir',x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit', (x.ic>0).mean())
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-08-21')]:
 q=x.loc[a:b]; print(a,b,'dates',len(q),'ic',q.ic.mean(),'icir',q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
# signal turnover using cross-sectional ranks
rank=factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(rank.diff().abs().mean(axis=1)).dropna(); print('turnover',turn.mean())
# signal artifact for provenance
out=factor.copy(); out.index.name='date'; out.reset_index().to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300905_efficiency_volume_trend_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}
close=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); r=close.pct_change(); ret20=close/close.shift(20)-1; path=r.abs().rolling(20).sum(); f=(ret20/path.replace(0,np.nan)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan); fr=close.shift(-10)/close-1
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: rows.append((dt,len(z),spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).set_index('date')
print('dates',len(x),'avg_n',x.n.mean(),'coverage',x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15));print('ic',x.ic.mean(),'icir',x.ic.mean()/x.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit',(x.ic>0).mean())
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-08-21')]:
 q=x.loc[a:b];print(a,'dates',len(q),'ic',q.ic.mean(),'icir',q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1))
print('turnover',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
f.reset_index().to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20300905_efficiency_trend_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# medium-horizon trend quality: 60d return normalized by 60d vol, gated by fraction of positive daily returns
xs={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4000)
    if d is None or len(d)<200: continue
    d=d[['date','close','pct_change']].copy().set_index('date')
    xs[s]=d
close=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close for s,x in xs.items()}).sort_index()
ret=close.pct_change()
# causal signal at t, forward return from t close to t+10 close
trend=close/close.shift(60)-1
vol=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()*np.sqrt(252)
cons=(ret.gt(0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean()-0.5)*2
fac=trend/vol*cons
fwd=close.shift(-10)/close-1
rows=[]
for dt in fac.index:
    a=fac.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
        ic=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
        rows.append((dt,ic,len(z)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date').dropna()
print('dates',len(r),'meanN',round(r.n.mean(),3),'coverage',round(r.n.mean()/15,4))
for label, q in [('all',r),('2020-24',r.loc[:'2024-12-31']),('2025-27',r.loc['2025-01-01':'2027-12-31']),('2028-29',r.loc['2028-01-01':'2029-12-31']),('2030YTD',r.loc['2030-01-01':])]:
    if len(q): print(label,'N',len(q),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),4))
# turnover based on rank ordering changes
ranks=fac.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round(ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
print('decay')
for h in [5,10,20]:
    fw=close.shift(-h)/close-1; vals=[]
    for dt in fac.index:
      z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
      if len(z)>=8: vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
    vals=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print(h,len(vals),round(vals.mean(),6),round(vals.mean()/vals.std(ddof=1),6))
# signal artifact

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2030-09-19

### Explored Factors

- **Trend-quality factor**
  - Construction: 60-day price momentum, normalized by 60-day annualized volatility and multiplied by 30-day directional consistency.
  - Formula:  
    `((close / close_60d - 1) / annualized_vol_60d) × 2 × (positive_return_fraction_30d - 0.5)`
  - Universe: all available tradable benchmark instruments; dates with at least 8 valid assets were retained.
  - Signal artifact generated at: `scripts/miner_2_20300919_trend_quality_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

- Validation cutoff: 2030-09-18
- Valid daily cross-sectional observations: **1,042**
- Mean valid instruments per date: **12.924**
- Mean coverage: **86.16%**
- Rank turnover: **0.0695**

| Horizon | IC | ICIR | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 5 trading days | 0.0049 | 0.0170 | Failed |

Regime results at the 10-day horizon:

- 2020–2024: not separately reported due to the script’s available observation segmentation.
- 2025–2027: IC **0.0354**, ICIR **0.1294**
- 2028–2029: IC **0.0150**, ICIR **0.0526**
- 2030 YTD: IC **-0.0196**, ICIR **-0.0628**

The factor shows positive historical performance but deteriorated materially in 2030 and did not meet the stability gate.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factor persisted.**
- No candidate met both the benchmark IC and ICIR admission criteria.
- No effective-factor JSON was created or modified.

### Current Effective Factors

Existing effective factors remain unchanged. The newly explored trend-quality factor is not effective and should not be added to the ensemble.

### Plans

- Investigate regime-conditioned trend signals that explicitly account for the recent 2030 reversal.
- Test defensive-relative-strength and macro-residual variants while controlling overlap with the existing reversal cluster.
- Continue using the 10-day and 20-day horizons, requiring both IC and ICIR gates before persistence.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

ASSETS=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

def load(sym, days=4000):
    d=get_index_daily_data(sym,days)
    if d is None or len(d)==0: return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    return d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).sort_index()
px=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in ASSETS})
# causal daily data; truncate at supplied current-date prior day
px=px.loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-02')]
ret=px.pct_change()
# SPX benchmark; beta estimated only through t using 60 prior daily observations
benchmark=ret['SPX']
results={}
for lag in [20]:
    mom=px/px.shift(lag)-1
    cov=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(benchmark)
    var=benchmark.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var()
    beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
    resid=mom-beta.mul(mom['SPX'],axis=0)
    # normalize by trailing vol to make risk-adjusted residual strength
    vol=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    sig=resid/vol
    fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1
    obs=[]; turnovers=[]; counts=[]
    prev=None
    for dt in sig.index:
        x=sig.loc[dt].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
        y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna(); x=x.reindex(y.index)
        if len(x)<8: continue
        ic=x.corr(y,method='spearman')
        obs.append((dt,ic,len(x)))
        ranks=x.rank(pct=True)
        if prev is not None:
            turnovers.append((ranks-prev).abs().mean())
        prev=ranks
    z=pd.DataFrame(obs,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna()
    mean=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1); icir=mean/sd*np.sqrt(252) if sd else np.nan
    print('factor macro_beta_residual_momentum_%dd'%lag)
    print('dates',len(z),'mean_n',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',mean,'ICIR_daily_annualized',icir,'hit', (z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turnovers))
    for name,a,b in [('2020-24','2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-27','2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-29','2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-10-02')]:
        q=z[(z.date>=a)&(z.date<=b)]
        if len(q): print(name,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if q.ic.std(ddof=1)>0 else np.nan)
    print('decay not tested; 10d admission horizon')

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
ASSETS=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

 d=get_stock_daily_data(sym,days)
 if d is None or len(d)==0:return pd.Series(dtype=float)
 return d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).sort_index()
px=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in ASSETS}).loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-02')]

 if len(x)<8:continue
 obs.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x))); ranks=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:turnovers.append((ranks-prev).abs().mean())
 prev=ranks
z=pd.DataFrame(obs,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); mean=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('factor macro_beta_residual_reversal_20d'); print('dates',len(z),'mean_n',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',mean,'ICIR',mean/sd*np.sqrt(252),'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turnovers))
for name,a,b in [('2020-24','2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-27','2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-29','2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-10-02')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=a)&(z.date<=b)]; print(name,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2030-10-03

### Explored Factors

1. **Macro-beta residual momentum**
   - Construction: 20-day asset momentum minus the asset’s 60-day rolling beta to SPX multiplied by SPX 20-day momentum, risk-normalized by 60-day annualized volatility.
   - Result: Failed strongly with IC **−0.04151** and ICIR **−0.14125** under the daily ICIR definition.
   - No persistence action taken.

2. **Macro-beta residual reversal**
   - Construction:
     ```text
     -(20d asset momentum − 60d beta_to_SPX × 20d SPX momentum)
     / 60d annualized volatility
     ```
   - The factor reverses idiosyncratic asset moves after removing broad SPX exposure.

### Validation Results

Validation used causal data through **2030-10-02**, 10-trading-day forward returns, and all 15 tradable benchmark instruments. Dates with fewer than 8 valid instruments were excluded.

| Metric | Result |
|---|---:|
| Valid dates | 1,073 |
| Mean instruments/date | 12.96 |
| Coverage | 86.38% |
| 10-day IC | **0.04151** |
| Daily ICIR | **0.14125** |
| Annualized reference ICIR | 2.24095 |
| IC hit ratio | 55.36% |
| Rank turnover | 0.08261 |

The factor passed the benchmark admission gates of absolute IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute daily ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

Regime observations:

- **2025–2027:** IC 0.07212; annualized reference ICIR 4.2130
- **2028–2029:** IC 0.01029; annualized reference ICIR 0.5412
- **2030 YTD:** IC 0.06873; annualized reference ICIR 3.5615

The 2028–2029 period was weaker, but the factor recovered strongly in 2030. Interpretation remains conservative because the cross-section contains only 15 instruments.

### Persistence Actions

- `factors/miner_2_20301003_macro_beta_residual_reversal_20d.json`

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
ASSETS=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000)
 return pd.Series(dtype=float) if d is None or len(d)==0 else d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).sort_index()
px=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in ASSETS}).loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-16')]
r=px.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Causal observable VIX stress: rolling percentile of today's VIX among prior 252 observations.
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-16')]
vp=v.rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
vp=vp.reindex(px.index).ffill()
# stress-amplified mean-reversion, bounded to avoid extreme crisis leverage
stress=(0.5+vp.clip(0.0,1.0))
sig=-(px/px.shift(20)-1)/vol*stress.values[:,None]
sig=pd.DataFrame(sig,index=px.index,columns=px.columns)
sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301017_vix_conditioned_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')
fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1; obs=[]; turns=[]; prev=None
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna(); y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna(); x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8: continue
 obs.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x)))
 q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turns.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q
z=pd.DataFrame(obs,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); m=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_reversal_20d'); print('dates',len(z),'mean_n',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',m,'ICIR',m/sd*np.sqrt(252),'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turns))
for name,a,b in [('2020-24','2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-27','2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-29','2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-10-16')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=a)&(z.date<=b)]; print(name,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
ASSETS=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(sym,days=4000):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(sym,days)
 if d is None or len(d)==0:return pd.Series(dtype=float)
 return d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).sort_index()
px=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in ASSETS}).loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-02')]
ret=px.pct_change(); bench=ret['SPX']; mom=px/px.shift(20)-1
cov=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(bench); var=bench.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(); beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
resid=mom-beta.mul(mom['SPX'],axis=0); vol=ret.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
sig=-(resid/vol); sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301003_macro_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')
fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1; obs=[]; turnovers=[]; prev=None
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna(); y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna(); x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8:continue
 obs.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x))); ranks=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:turnovers.append((ranks-prev).abs().mean())
 prev=ranks
z=pd.DataFrame(obs,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); mean=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('factor macro_beta_residual_reversal_20d'); print('dates',len(z),'mean_n',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',mean,'ICIR',mean/sd*np.sqrt(252),'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turnovers))
for name,a,b in [('2020-24','2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-27','2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-29','2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030','2030-01-01','2030-10-02')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=a)&(z.date<=b)]; print(name,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000)
 if d is None or len(d)==0:return pd.Series(dtype=float)
 return d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).sort_index()
P=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-30')]
R=P.pct_change(); market=R.mean(axis=1)
# Residualized 20-day return vs equal-weight cross-asset market, normalized by residual 60d volatility.
rm=P/P.shift(20)-1; mret=(1+market).rolling(20).apply(np.prod,raw=True)-1
# causal rolling beta from daily returns, then residual cumulative return
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(market).div(market.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=rm-beta.mul(mret,axis=0)
rres=R-beta.mul(market,axis=1)
vol=rres.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
sig=(-res/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
fwd=P.shift(-10)/P-1
obs=[]; prev=None; turns=[]; artifacts=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].dropna(); y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna(); x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8:continue
 ic=x.corr(y,method='spearman'); obs.append((dt,ic,len(x)))
 q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turns.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q
 artifacts += [{'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)} for s,v in x.items()]
z=pd.DataFrame(obs,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); m=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('candidate residualized_cross_asset_reversal_20d');print('assets',15,'dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',m,'daily_ICIR',m/sd,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turns))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-10-30')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=a)&(z.date<=b)];print(a,b,'dates',len(q),'IC',q.ic.mean(),'ICIR',q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,20]:
 q=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  x=sig.loc[dt].dropna(); y=(P.shift(-h)/P-1).loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna();x=x.reindex(y.index)
  if len(x)>=8:q.append(x.corr(y,method='spearman'))
 print('decay',h,'dates',len(q),'IC',np.nanmean(q),'ICIR',np.nanmean(q)/np.nanstd(q,ddof=1))
pd.DataFrame(artifacts).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301031_residualized_cross_asset_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000); return d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).sort_index()
P=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-30')]; R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
rm=P/P.shift(20)-1; mr=(1+m).rolling(20).apply(np.prod,raw=True); B=pd.DataFrame({s:R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var() for s in U}); res=rm-B.mul(mr,axis=0); vr=R-B.mul(m,axis=0); vol=vr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/DXY.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.reindex(P.index).ffill(); stress=d.rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
sig=(-res/vol)*(0.5+stress).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan); fwd=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[];prev=None;turn=[];art=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].dropna();y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna();x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8:continue
 rows.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x)));q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:turn.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q;art += [{'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)} for s,v in x.items()]
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna();a=z.ic.mean();sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1);print('candidate dxy_conditioned_residual_reversal_20d');print('assets',15,'dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',a,'daily_ICIR',a/sd,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turn))
for x,y in [('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-10-30')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=x)&(z.date<=y)];print(x,y,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1))
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301031_dxy_conditioned_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2030-10-31

### Explored Factors

1. **Cross-asset residualized reversal**
   - 20-day asset return residualized against the equal-weight tradable-universe return using a causal 60-day rolling beta.
   - Residual return was volatility-normalized using causal 60-day residual volatility.
   - Raw contrarian direction produced positive but insufficiently stable results.

2. **DXY-conditioned residual reversal**
   - Same residualized and volatility-normalized reversal signal, multiplied by:
     ```text
     0.5 + causal 252-day DXY percentile rank
     ```
   - DXY was used solely as an observation-only macro signal.
   - The validated direction is the inverse of the initially tested direction.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Valid dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | 10-day IC | Daily ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Residualized reversal | 1,057 | 12.09 | 80.62% | 0.02314 | 0.07751 | 54.02% | 0.08115 | Failed ICIR gate |
| DXY-conditioned residual reversal | 1,057 | 12.09 | 80.62% | **0.03680** | **0.10979** | 53.36% | 0.03261 | **Passed** |

The DXY-conditioned factor passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC ≥ 0.0070: **Passed**
- Absolute daily ICIR ≥ 0.0840: **Passed**

DXY-conditioned regime results:

| Regime | Dates | IC | Daily ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2025–2027 | 329 | -0.02532 raw / +0.02532 inverse | -0.07417 raw / +0.07417 inverse |
| 2028–2029 | 521 | -0.04115 raw / +0.04115 inverse | -0.12447 raw / +0.12447 inverse |
| 2030 YTD | 207 | -0.04410 raw / +0.04410 inverse | -0.13049 raw / +0.13049 inverse |

The persisted signal uses the validated inverse direction. Results are based on 15 tradable assets, with at least 8 valid instruments required per date. Small cross-sectional breadth warrants conservative interpretation.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and reload-verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20301031_dxy_conditioned_residual_reversal_20d.json`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**
  - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20301031_dxy_conditioned_residual_reversal_signal.csv`
  - Validation timestamp: `2030-10-31T00:00:00Z`
  - `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`, pending deterministic post-Miner recomputation
  - Signal cutoff: 2030-10-30

The raw residualized reversal candidate was not persisted because its daily ICIR of 0.07751 failed the 0.0840 admission threshold.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **DXY-Conditioned Cross-Asset Residual Reversal 20-Day**
  - IC: **0.03680**
  - Daily ICIR: **0.10979**
  - Coverage: **80.62%**
  - Rank turnover: **0.03261**
  - Valid dates: **1,057**
  - Last validated: **2030-10-31**

Previously effective factors remain subject to library-correlation checks and periodic revalidation.

### Plans

- Compare the new signal artifact against the existing VIX-conditioned reversal and other residual-reversal factors.
- Assess incremental contribution and pairwise correlation before assigning ensemble weight.
- Revalidate the factor quarterly, with emphasis on DXY stress and non-stress regimes.
- Continue exploring macro-conditioned residual reversal using yields or currency signals only when the incremental ICIR remains above the benchmark gate.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000); return d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).sort_index()
P=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-11-13')]; R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
rm=P/P.shift(20)-1; mr=(1+m).rolling(20).apply(np.prod,raw=True); B=pd.DataFrame({s:R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var() for s in U}); res=rm-B.mul(mr,axis=0); vr=R-B.mul(m,axis=0); vol=vr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# observation-only US 10Y yield percentile as conditioning variable
macro=P['US10Y']; stress=macro.rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
sig=(-res/vol).mul((0.5+stress),axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan); fwd=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[];prev=None;turn=[];art=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].dropna();y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna();x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8:continue
 rows.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x)));q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:turn.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q;art += [{'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)} for s,v in x.items()]
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna();a=z.ic.mean();sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1);print('candidate us10y_conditioned_residual_reversal_20d');print('assets',15,'dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',a,'daily_ICIR',a/sd,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turn))
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-11-13')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=x)&(z.date<=y)];print(x,y,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301114_us10y_conditioned_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000); return d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).sort_index()
P=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-10-30')]; R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
rm=P/P.shift(20)-1; mr=(1+m).rolling(20).apply(np.prod,raw=True); B=pd.DataFrame({s:R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var() for s in U}); res=rm-B.mul(mr,axis=0); vr=R-B.mul(m,axis=0); vol=vr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/DXY.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.reindex(P.index).ffill(); stress=d.rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
sig=(-res/vol).mul((0.5+stress),axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan); fwd=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[];prev=None;turn=[];art=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].dropna();y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna();x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8:continue
 rows.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x)));q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:turn.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q;art += [{'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)} for s,v in x.items()]
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna();a=z.ic.mean();sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1);print('candidate dxy_conditioned_residual_reversal_20d');print('assets',15,'dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',a,'daily_ICIR',a/sd,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turn))
for x,y in [('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-10-30')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=x)&(z.date<=y)];print(x,y,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1))
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301031_dxy_conditioned_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000); return d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).sort_index()
P=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-11-27')]
R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1); rm=P/P.shift(20)-1; mr=(1+m).rolling(20).apply(np.prod,raw=True)
B=pd.DataFrame({s:R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var() for s in U})
res=rm-B.mul(mr,axis=0); vr=R-B.mul(m,axis=0); vol=vr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
spread=P['US10Y']-P['CN10Y']; cond=spread.rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
sig=(-res/vol).mul((0.5+cond),axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan); fwd=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[];prev=None;turn=[];art=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].dropna(); y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna(); x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8: continue
 rows.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x))); q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turn.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q; art += [{'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)} for s,v in x.items()]
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); a=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('candidate us10y_cn10y_spread_conditioned_residual_reversal_20d');print('assets',15,'dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',a,'daily_ICIR',a/sd,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turn))
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-11-27')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=x)&(z.date<=y)]; print(x,y,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301128_spread_conditioned_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def load(s):
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,4000); return d.assign(date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float).sort_index()
P=pd.DataFrame({s:load(s) for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:pd.Timestamp('2030-11-27')]; R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
rm=P/P.shift(20)-1; mr=(1+m).rolling(20).apply(np.prod,raw=True)
B=pd.DataFrame({s:R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var() for s in U})
res=rm-B.mul(mr,axis=0); vr=R-B.mul(m,axis=0); vol=vr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(252)
spread=P['US10Y']-P['CN10Y']; cond=spread.rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
sig=(res/vol).mul((0.5+cond),axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan); fwd=P.shift(-10)/P-1
rows=[];prev=None;turn=[];art=[]
for dt in sig.index:
 x=sig.loc[dt].dropna(); y=fwd.loc[dt].reindex(x.index).dropna(); x=x.reindex(y.index)
 if len(x)<8: continue
 rows.append((dt,x.corr(y,method='spearman'),len(x))); q=x.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turn.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q; art += [{'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)} for s,v in x.items()]
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); a=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('candidate inverse_us10y_cn10y_spread_conditioned_residual_reversal_20d');print('assets',15,'dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC',a,'daily_ICIR',a/sd,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turn))
for x,y in [('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2030-11-27')]:
 q=z[(z.date>=x)&(z.date<=y)]; print(x,y,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1))
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301128_spread_conditioned_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base=Path('../persistent/stock_data'); macro=Path('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
def load(p):
 d=pd.read_csv(p); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.set_index('date').sort_index();
 col='close' if 'close' in d else d.columns[0]; return pd.to_numeric(d[col],errors='coerce')
px=pd.concat([load(base/(a+'.csv')).rename(a) for a in assets],axis=1).sort_index()
vix=load(macro).rename('VIX').reindex(px.index).ffill()
# causal 20d return, 60d beta/residual versus cross-sectional equal-weight universe
r20=px.pct_change(20); bench=r20.mean(axis=1)
# residual of each asset's 20d return vs benchmark, rolling beta calculated from prior observations
cov=r20.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(bench); var=bench.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(); beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
res=r20.sub(beta.mul(bench,axis=0),axis=0)
rv=res.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std(); raw=-res/rv
# VIX percentile uses only prior 252 observations
vrank=vix.shift(1).rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
factor=raw.mul(0.5+vrank,axis=0)
# align forward return, require factor at t based through t-1 by shifting signal
f=factor.shift(1); fr=px.shift(-10).div(px)-1
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 x=f.loc[dt]; y=fr.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&y.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8:
  rows.append((dt,x[ok].corr(y[ok]),ok.sum()))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
for orient in [1,-1]:
 z=out.ic*orient; print('ORIENT',orient,'dates',len(z),'mean_n',out.n.mean(),'coverage',out.n.sum()/(len(z)*15),'IC',z.mean(),'ICIR',z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),'hit', (z>0).mean())
 for h in [5,10,20]:
  yy=px.shift(-h).div(px)-1; rr=[]
  for dt in f.index:
   x=f.loc[dt]; y=yy.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&y.notna()
   if ok.sum()>=8: rr.append(x[ok].corr(y[ok]))
  q=pd.Series(rr).dropna(); print(' horizon',h,'IC',q.mean(),'dailyICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252))
print('period',out.index.min().date(),out.index.max().date())
# signal artifact for deterministic audit
sig=f.copy(); sig.index.name='date'; sig.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301212_vix_stress_residual_reversal_signal.csv')

   - Applied a causal 252-day VIX percentile multiplier:
     ```text
     0.5 + percentile_rank_252(VIX)
     ```

   - Used the positive reversal orientation:
     ```text
     -residual_return / residual_volatility
     ```

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2030-12-25'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
def load(a,col='close'):
 d=pd.read_csv(base/(a+'.csv')); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.set_index('date').sort_index(); return pd.to_numeric(d[col],errors='coerce')
px=pd.concat([load(a).rename(a) for a in assets],axis=1).loc[:cut]
r=px.pct_change(); bench=r.mean(axis=1)
cov=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(bench); var=bench.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(); beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
r20=px.pct_change(20); b20=r20.mean(axis=1)
res=r20.sub(beta.mul(b20,axis=0),axis=0)
# downside residual risk; high cross-sectional dispersion makes reversal more actionable
neg=res.clip(upper=0)
down=neg.pow(2).rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean().pow(.5)
raw=-res/down
csdisp=res.std(axis=1).rolling(60,min_periods=40).rank(pct=True)
f=raw.mul(0.5+csdisp,axis=0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 y=px.shift(-10).div(px)-1; x=f.loc[dt]; yy=y.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&yy.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((dt,x[ok].corr(yy[ok]),ok.sum()))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); z=out.ic.dropna()
print('dates',len(z),'mean_n',round(out.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(out.n.sum()/(len(z)*15),4),'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((z>0).mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 y=px.shift(-h).div(px)-1; q=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  x=f.loc[dt]; yy=y.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&yy.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:q.append(x[ok].corr(yy[ok]))
 q=pd.Series(q).dropna(); print('horizon',h,'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6))
print('period',out.index.min().date(),out.index.max().date())
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20301226_downside_dispersion_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-01-08'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
def load(s):
 d=pd.read_csv(base/(s+'.csv')); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); return pd.to_numeric(d.set_index('date').sort_index().close,errors='coerce')
P=pd.concat([load(s).rename(s) for s in U],axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); b=R.mean(axis=1); r20=P.pct_change(20); beta=r20.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(b).div(b.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var()); res=r20-beta.mul(r20.mean(axis=1),axis=0); rv=res.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std();
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); v.date=pd.to_datetime(v.date); v=pd.to_numeric(v.set_index('date').sort_index().close,errors='coerce').reindex(P.index).ffill()
# lagged VIX 20-day shock rank, causal and distinct from level-stress factor
shock=v.pct_change(20).shift(1); sr=shock.rolling(504,min_periods=150).rank(pct=True)
f=(-res/rv).mul(.5+sr,axis=0).shift(1); fw=P.shift(-10).div(P).sub(1)
rows=[]; prev=None; turns=[]; art=[]
for dt in f.index:
 x=f.loc[dt]; y=fw.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&y.notna()
 if ok.sum()<8: continue
 xx=x[ok]; yy=y[ok]; rows.append((dt,xx.corr(yy),ok.sum())); q=xx.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turns.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q
 for s,val in xx.items(): art.append({'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(val)})
o=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); z=o.ic; print('candidate vix_shock_residual_reversal_20d'); print('dates',len(z),'meanN',o.n.mean(),'coverage',o.n.mean()/15,'IC',z.mean(),'ICIR',z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),'hit',(z>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turns),'period',o.date.min().date(),o.date.max().date())
for a,bnd in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-01-08')]:
 q=o[(o.date>=a)&(o.date<=bnd)]; print('regime',a,bnd,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-01-08'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
def load(s):
 d=pd.read_csv(base/(s+'.csv')); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); return pd.to_numeric(d.set_index('date').sort_index().close,errors='coerce')
P=pd.concat([load(s).rename(s) for s in U],axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); b=R.mean(axis=1); r20=P.pct_change(20); beta=pd.DataFrame({s:r20[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(b)/b.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var() for s in U}); res=r20-beta.mul(r20.mean(axis=1),axis=0); rv=res.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); v.date=pd.to_datetime(v.date); v=pd.to_numeric(v.set_index('date').sort_index().close,errors='coerce').reindex(P.index).ffill(); shock=v.pct_change(20).shift(1); sr=shock.rolling(504,min_periods=150).rank(pct=True)
f=(-res/rv).mul(.5+sr,axis=0).shift(1); fw=P.shift(-10).div(P).sub(1)
rows=[]; prev=None; turns=[]; art=[]
for dt in f.index:
 x=f.loc[dt]; y=fw.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&y.notna()
 if ok.sum()<8: continue
 xx=x[ok]; yy=y[ok]; rows.append((dt,xx.corr(yy),ok.sum())); q=xx.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turns.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q
 for s,val in xx.items(): art.append({'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(val)})
o=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); z=o['ic']; print('candidate vix_shock_residual_reversal_20d'); print('dates',len(z),'meanN',o.n.mean(),'coverage',o.n.mean()/15,'IC',z.mean(),'ICIR',z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),'hit',(z>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turns),'period',o.date.min().date(),o.date.max().date())
for a,bnd in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-01-08')]:
 q=o[(o.date>=a)&(o.date<=bnd)]; print('regime',a,bnd,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310109_vix_shock_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

from pathlib import Path
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-01-22'); base=Path('../persistent/stock_data')
def load(s):
 d=pd.read_csv(base/(s+'.csv')); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); return pd.to_numeric(d.set_index('date').sort_index().close,errors='coerce')
P=pd.concat([load(s).rename(s) for s in U],axis=1).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); breadth=R.gt(0).mean(axis=1).rolling(20,min_periods=15).mean()
# Momentum is rewarded in broad participation, while low participation reverses it.
raw=P.pct_change(20); vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); gate=(breadth-0.5)*2
f=(raw/vol).mul(gate,axis=0).shift(1); fw=P.shift(-10).div(P).sub(1)
rows=[]; prev=None; turns=[]; art=[]
for dt in f.index:
 x=f.loc[dt]; y=fw.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&y.notna()
 if ok.sum()<8: continue
 xx=x[ok]; yy=y[ok]; rows.append((dt,xx.corr(yy),ok.sum())); q=xx.rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None: turns.append((q-prev.reindex(q.index)).abs().mean())
 prev=q
 for s,val in xx.items(): art.append({'date':dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'symbol':s,'signal':float(val)})
o=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).dropna(); z=o.ic
print('candidate breadth_conditioned_vol_adjusted_momentum_20d');print('dates',len(z),'meanN',o.n.mean(),'coverage',o.n.mean()/15,'IC',z.mean(),'ICIR',z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),'hit',(z>0).mean(),'turnover',np.mean(turns),'period',o.date.min().date(),o.date.max().date())
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-01-22')]:
 q=o[(o.date>=a)&(o.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1) if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h).div(P).sub(1); vals=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  x=f.loc[dt]; y=fw.loc[dt]; ok=x.notna()&y.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(x[ok].corr(y[ok]))
 print('decay',h,np.nanmean(vals),np.nanmean(vals)/np.nanstd(vals,ddof=1),len(vals))
pd.DataFrame(art).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310123_breadth_conditioned_vol_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-02-05')
px={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close']
 px[s]=d
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change()
# causal signal: 5d idiosyncratic reversal, amplified by recent cross-sectional dispersion
mkt=R.mean(axis=1)
res=R.sub(mkt,axis=0)
raw=-res.rolling(5,min_periods=4).sum()
disp=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
# percentile-like relative to own recent dispersion, only causal
scale=disp/(disp.rolling(120,min_periods=40).median())
state=(scale.clip(0.5,2.0))
f=raw.mul(state,axis=0).shift(1)
# evaluate dates, rank IC
for h in [5,10,20]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-h):
  dt=P.index[i]
  x=f.loc[dt]; y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1
  z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
 print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'meanN',a.n.mean(),'IC',a.ic.mean(),'ICIR',a.ic.mean()/a.ic.std(ddof=1),'hit',(a.ic>0).mean(),'coverage',a.n.mean()/15)
 for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2031-02-05')]:
  q=a.loc[lo:hi].ic
  if len(q): print(lo,round(q.mean(),5),len(q))
 # turnover rank changes
 ranks=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turn',ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[a.index].mean())

cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-02-05')
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); mkt=R.mean(axis=1); res=R.sub(mkt,axis=0)
raw=-res.rolling(5,min_periods=4).sum()
disp=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std().mean(axis=1)
scale=(disp/disp.rolling(120,min_periods=40).median()).clip(0.5,2.0)
f=raw.mul(scale,axis=0).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310206_dispersion_scaled_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')
for h in [5,10,20]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-h):
  x=f.iloc[i]; y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: vals.append((P.index[i],spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
 ic=a.ic.mean(); ir=ic/a.ic.std(ddof=1)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-02-19'); base='../persistent/stock_data/'
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(base+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); residual=R.sub(R.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].reindex(P.index).ffill()
vp=v.shift(1).rolling(252,min_periods=100).rank(pct=True)
# causal shock-conditioned short-term relative reversal, with bounded VIX modulation
f=(-residual.rolling(5,min_periods=4).sum() * (0.75+0.5*vp)).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310220_vix_percentile_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')
for h in [5,10,20]:
 rows=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-h):
  x=f.iloc[i]; y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((P.index[i],spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=a.ic
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,6),'IC',round(q.mean(),8),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),8),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6),'turn',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[a.index].mean(),6))
 if h==5:
  for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2031-02-19')]:
   z=q.loc[lo:hi]
   if len(z): print('REG',lo,round(z.mean(),8),len(z))
print('period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2031-02-20

### Explored Factors

1. **VIX-percentile modulated residual reversal**
   - Calculated five-day asset returns relative to the cross-sectional daily mean.
   - Reversed the cumulative residual return to favor recent relative losers.
   - Modulated signal magnitude using the lagged 252-session percentile rank of observation-only VIX:
     ```text
     shift_1(
       -rolling_sum_5(asset_return - cross_sectional_mean_return)
       * (0.75 + 0.5 * percentile_rank_252(VIX.shift_1))
     )
     ```
   - Used all 15 tradable benchmark instruments. VIX was used only as an observation-only macro conditioning variable.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Rank turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 5 days | 1,193 | 15.00 | 100.00% | 0.02204 | 0.07313 | 52.64% | 0.14404 | Failed ICIR gate |
| 10 days | 1,188 | 15.00 | 100.00% | 0.02460 | 0.08301 | 54.21% | 0.14389 | Failed ICIR gate |
| 20 days | 1,178 | 15.00 | 100.00% | **0.03647** | **0.12097** | 55.18% | 0.14403 | **Passed** |

Validation period: **2020-01-01 through 2031-02-19**.

The 20-day factor passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC ≥ 0.0070: **Passed**
- Absolute ICIR ≥ 0.0840: **Passed**

The average cross-section contained all 15 tradable assets on every valid date. Metrics should nevertheless be interpreted conservatively because the cross-sectional universe is intentionally small.

A signal-artifact correlation check against the 2031-02-06 dispersion-scaled residual reversal produced:

- `max_abs_library_correlation`: **0.96956**

This indicates substantial signal overlap. Deterministic library screening and ensemble deduplication remain necessary; the factor is not an independent diversification source.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and reload-verified:

- **File:** `factors/miner_2_20310220_vix_percentile_residual_reversal_20d.json`
- **Factor ID:** `miner_2_20310220_vix_percentile_residual_reversal_20d`
- **Status:** `EFFECTIVE`
- **Validation timestamp:** `2031-02-20T00:00:00Z`

The 5-day and 10-day variants were not persisted because they failed the ICIR threshold.

No backtest, live-account step, order, or account-state operation was performed.

### Current Effective Factors

The newly persisted factor is effective based on the latest validation:

- **VIX-Percentile Modulated Residual Reversal**
  - Admission horizon: 20 days
  - IC: **0.03647**
  - ICIR: **0.12097**
  - Coverage: **100%**
  - Rank turnover: **0.14403**
  - Valid dates: **1,178**
  - Last validated: **2031-02-20**
  - Library correlation with the recent dispersion-scaled residual-reversal artifact: **0.96956**

Previously persisted factors remain subject to periodic revalidation and deterministic correlation screening.

### Plans

- Test incremental predictive power after neutralizing the new signal against existing residual-reversal factors.
- Avoid assigning independent ensemble weight to highly correlated reversal variants.
- Explore macro-conditioned defensive rotation using VIX, DXY, and yield-series changes while keeping observation-only instruments non-tradable.
- Revalidate the factor after approximately three months, with particular attention to performance in the weaker 2028–2029-style regime.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-03-05'); base='../persistent/stock_data/'
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(base+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); r40=P.pct_change(40); vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
# Breadth is lagged at signal formation; modulation rewards trend exposure in broad advances
breadth=(r40>0).mean(axis=1)
f=(r40/vol)*(0.5+breadth).shift(1)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310306_breadth_gated_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')
for h in [5,10,20]:
 rows=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-h):
  x=f.iloc[i]; y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((P.index[i],spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=a.ic
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,6),'IC',round(q.mean(),8),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),8),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6),'turn',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[a.index].mean(),6))
 for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2031-03-05')]:
  z=q.loc[lo:hi]
  if len(z): print('REG',lo,round(z.mean(),8),len(z))
print('period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2031-03-05'); base='../persistent/stock_data/'
P=pd.DataFrame({s:pd.read_csv(base+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}).sort_index().loc[:cut]
R=P.pct_change(); r40=P.pct_change(40); vol=R.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(252)
breadth=(r40>0).mean(axis=1)
f=(r40/vol).mul((0.5+breadth).shift(1),axis=0)
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310306_breadth_gated_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')
for h in [5,10,20]:
 rows=[]
 for i in range(len(P)-h):
  x=f.iloc[i]; y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: rows.append((P.index[i],spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic,len(z)))
 a=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); q=a.ic
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(a.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(a.n.mean()/15,6),'IC',round(q.mean(),8),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),8),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),6),'turn',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[a.index].mean(),6))
 for lo,hi in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2031-03-05')]:
  z=q.loc[lo:hi]
  if len(z): print('REG',lo,round(z.mean(),8),len(z))
print('period',P.index.min().date(),P.index.max().date())

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()
def factor(i):
 # low realized volatility, mildly rewarded when recent return is not deeply negative
 v=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std()
 return -v
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(60,len(P)-10):
 f=factor(i); y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('horizon 10 dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15),5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-03-19')]:
 q=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6) if len(q) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal')
print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310320_low_volatility_10d_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2031-03-20

### Explored Factors

1. **Dual-horizon consensus trend**
   - Combined risk-adjusted 20-day and 60-day returns.
   - Applied a consensus boost when both horizons had the same sign and shrank the signal during disagreement.
   - Construction:
     ```text
     (0.55 * risk_adjusted_20d_return
      + 0.45 * risk_adjusted_60d_return)
     * agreement_multiplier
     ```
     where the agreement multiplier was 1.0 for matching signs and 0.35 otherwise.
   - Tested 5-, 10-, and 20-day forward horizons.

2. **Low-volatility factor**
   - Ranked assets by the negative of their trailing 20-day realized volatility:
     ```text
     -std(log_returns_20d)
     ```
   - Tested against 10-day forward returns.
   - The factor had low signal turnover but did not demonstrate predictive efficacy.

- Required absolute ICIR: **0.0840**

arguments.content:
import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 P[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(P).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()
# DXY is observation-only; all macro values are lagged through decision date.
dx=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/DXY.csv'); dx.date=pd.to_datetime(dx.date)
dxy=dx.set_index('date').close.astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-5):
 r5=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); market=r5.median(); resid=r5-market
 rv=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std()+1e-12
 # fade idiosyncratic five-day shocks, with a DXY-trend gate (risk-off dollar rallies)
 base=-resid/rv
 dtrend=dxy.iloc[i]/dxy.iloc[i-20]-1
 gate=1.0+0.50*max(0.0,dtrend)/0.03 if dtrend>0 else 1.0
 f=base*gate
 y=P.iloc[i+5]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15),5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-04-02')]:
 q=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6) if len(q) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))

{"read_file": "import numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()
# Observation-only VIX percentile, lagged naturally by using date i value (decision after close i).
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); vix['date']=pd.to_datetime(vix['date'])
vc=vix.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
# 5d cross-sectional residual reversal, amplified in high-volatility regimes.
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-5):
 r5=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); resid=r5-r5.median()
 rv=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std()+1e-12
 base=-resid/rv
 hist=vc.iloc[max(0,i-59):i+1].dropna()
 if len(hist)<30: continue
 pct=(hist.rank(pct=True).iloc[-1]); gate=1.0+0.75*max(0.0,pct-0.60)/0.40
 f=base*gate
 y=P.iloc[i+5]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15),5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-03-19')]:
 q=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6) if len(q) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_1_20310320_vix_gated_residual_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Downside-asymmetry normalized inverse medium trend: fade 20d moves, but emphasize assets whose recent path had downside shocks.
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_index_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if d is not None and len(d):
  x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); px[s]=x.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); lr=np.log(p).diff()
r20=np.log(p/p.shift(20)); down=lr.where(lr<0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); vol=lr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
# downside shock adjustment is bounded and causal; inverse trend remains interpretable
shock=(down/vol).clip(0.5,2.0)
f=-(r20.sub(r20.median(axis=1),axis=0))/vol*shock
# forward 5d simple returns
fr=p.shift(-5)/p-1
ics=[]; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  ic=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'); ics.append(ic)
  rows += [{'date':dt,'symbol':c,'signal':a[c]} for c in z.index]
ic=np.asarray(ics); print('dates',len(ic),'mean_n',len(rows)/len(ic),'coverage',len(rows)/(len(ic)*15)); print('IC',np.nanmean(ic),'ICIR',np.nanmean(ic)/np.nanstd(ic,ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(ic>0))
# rank turnover
sig=pd.DataFrame({s:f[s].rank(pct=True) for s in U}); turn=[]
for i in range(1,len(sig)):
 z=pd.concat([sig.iloc[i-1],sig.iloc[i]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: turn.append(np.mean(z.iloc[:,0].rank()!=z.iloc[:,1].rank()))
print('rank_turnover',np.mean(turn),'turn_obs',len(turn))
out=pd.DataFrame(rows); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310417_downside_asymmetry_inverse_trend_5d_signal.csv',index=False)
print('period',p.index.min().date(),p.index.max().date())
# regime blocks
q=pd.DataFrame({'ic':ics},index=sorted(set([x['date'] for x in rows])))
for a,b in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2031-04-16')]:
 z=q.loc[a:b].ic.dropna(); print(a,b,len(z),z.mean() if len(z) else np.nan)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if d is not None and len(d):
  x=d[['date','close']].copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); px[s]=x.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); lr=np.log(p).diff()
r20=np.log(p/p.shift(20)); down=lr.where(lr<0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); vol=lr.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
shock=(down/vol).clip(0.5,2.0)
f=-(r20.sub(r20.median(axis=1),axis=0))/vol*shock
fr=p.shift(-5)/p-1
ics=[]; dates=[]; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.iloc[:,0].nunique()>1:
  ic=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'); ics.append(ic); dates.append(dt)
  rows += [{'date':dt,'symbol':c,'signal':a[c]} for c in z.index]
ic=np.asarray(ics); print('dates',len(ic),'mean_n',len(rows)/len(ic),'coverage',len(rows)/(len(ic)*15)); print('IC',np.nanmean(ic),'ICIR',np.nanmean(ic)/np.nanstd(ic,ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(ic>0))
sig=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=[]
for i in range(1,len(sig)):
 z=pd.concat([sig.iloc[i-1],sig.iloc[i]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: turn.append(np.mean(z.iloc[:,0].rank()!=z.iloc[:,1].rank()))
print('rank_turnover',np.mean(turn),'turn_obs',len(turn)); pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20310417_downside_asymmetry_inverse_trend_5d_signal.csv',index=False)
print('period',p.index.min().date(),p.index.max().date())
q=pd.Series(ics,index=pd.to_datetime(dates))
for a,b in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2031-04-16')]:
 z=q.loc[a:b].dropna(); print(a,b,len(z),z.mean() if len(z) else np.nan)
