import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4600); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); v.date=pd.to_datetime(v.date); vc=[c for c in v.columns if c.lower() in ('close','value','vix')][0]; V=v.set_index('date')[vc].astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(150,len(P)-46):
 r=R.iloc[:i]; dn=np.minimum(r,0); dvol=np.sqrt((dn.iloc[-120:]**2).mean())+1e-12
 rel=r.iloc[-90:].sum()-r.iloc[-90:].sum().median()
 # slow reversal, normalized by asset downside volatility
 base=-rel/dvol
 breadth=(r.iloc[-20:].sum()>0).mean(); eqvol=r.iloc[-20:].mean(axis=1).std(); histvol=r.iloc[-120:].mean(axis=1).std()+1e-12
 bs=np.clip((.5-breadth)*2,0,1)*np.clip(eqvol/histvol,.5,2)
 z=(V.iloc[i-1]-V.iloc[i-61:i].mean())/(V.iloc[i-61:i].std()+1e-12); vs=np.clip(z,0,2)/2
 f=(base*(1+.60*bs+.50*vs)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(pct=True)
 for s,x in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(x)})
 y=P.iloc[i+45]/P.iloc[i]-1; q=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(q),q.f.corr(q.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',45,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-03-31')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330331_breadth_vix_downside_reversal_45d_signal.csv',index=False)

P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()

 bs=np.clip((.5-breadth)*2,0,1)*np.clip(eqvol/histvol,.5,2)

for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-04-13')]:

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Novel factor: 30d risk-adjusted momentum, rewarded only when 90d trend agrees;
# subtract cross-sectional median to emphasize relative trend while preserving rank direction.
for i in range(150,len(P)-21):
 r=R.iloc[:i]; dv=r.iloc[-90:].where(r.iloc[-90:]<0).std()*np.sqrt(252)
 dv=dv.replace(0,np.nan).fillna(r.iloc[-90:].std()*np.sqrt(252)).replace(0,np.nan)+1e-12
 raw=r.iloc[-30:].sum()/dv
 agree=np.sign(r.iloc[-90:].sum())
 f=(raw*agree).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 f=f-f.median()
 f=f.rank(pct=True)
 for s,x in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(x) if pd.notna(x) else np.nan})
 y=P.iloc[i+20]/P.iloc[i]-1; q=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(q),q.f.corr(q.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',20,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-04-27')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330428_agree_risk_momentum_20d_signal.csv',index=False)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# volatility compression: assets whose short realized vol is low relative to their long baseline
series={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=5000)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index()
        r=pd.to_numeric(d['close'],errors='coerce').pct_change()
        # causal factor observed at t; forward return t+1..t+10
        v20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v120=r.rolling(120,min_periods=80).std()
        series[s]=pd.DataFrame({'f':-(v20/v120-1.0),'p':pd.to_numeric(d['close'])})
all_dates=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in series.values()]))
ics=[]; turnovers=[]; nobs=[]; dates=[]
for i,t in enumerate(all_dates):
    vals=[]; fw=[]; sy=[]
    for s,x in series.items():
        if t not in x.index: continue
        loc=x.index.get_loc(t)
        if isinstance(loc,slice) or loc+10>=len(x): continue
        f=x.iloc[loc]['f']; p0=x.iloc[loc]['p']; p1=x.iloc[loc+10]['p']
        if np.isfinite(f) and p0>0 and p1>0:
            vals.append(f); fw.append(p1/p0-1); sy.append(s)
    if len(vals)>=8 and np.std(vals)>0 and np.std(fw)>0:
        ics.append(np.corrcoef(vals,fw)[0,1]); nobs.append(len(vals)); dates.append(t)
    # turnover of cross-sectional rank signal between consecutive usable dates is omitted here
ic=np.asarray(ics)
print('factor=volatility_compression horizon=10')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data, get_account_dict

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# acceleration: recent 20d return relative to prior 40d return, normalized by recent vol
xs={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=5000)
    if d is None or len(d)<150: continue
    d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    px=pd.to_numeric(d['close'],errors='coerce')
    r=np.log(px).diff()
    f=(np.log(px/px.shift(20))-np.log(px.shift(20)/px.shift(60))) / (r.rolling(60).std()*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12)
    # signal available at t, forward 10d return
    fr=np.log(px.shift(-10)/px)
    xs[s]=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'fr':fr})
all_dates=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in xs.values()]))
ics=[]; rows=[]
for dt in all_dates:
    a=[]
    for s,x in xs.items():
        if dt in x.index and np.isfinite(x.loc[dt,'f']) and np.isfinite(x.loc[dt,'fr']): a.append((s,x.loc[dt,'f'],x.loc[dt,'fr']))
    if len(a)>=8:
        z=pd.DataFrame(a,columns=['s','f','fr'])
        ic=z.f.corr(z.fr,method='spearman')
        if np.isfinite(ic): ics.append(ic); rows.append((dt,ic,len(a)))
ser=pd.Series([x[1] for x in rows], index=[x[0] for x in rows])
print('dates',len(rows),'mean_n',np.mean([x[2] for x in rows]),'coverage',np.mean([x[2] for x in rows])/15)
print('IC',ser.mean(),'ICIR',ser.mean()/ser.std(ddof=1),'hit',np.mean(ser>0),'turnover_proxy',np.mean(np.abs(ser.diff())))
for name,lo,hi in [('2020_24','2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025_27','2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028_29','2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030_now','2030-01-01','2033-05-20')]:

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for a in assets:
    x=get_index_daily_data(a, days=5000)
    if x is not None and len(x):
        x=x.copy(); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x['date']); D[a]=x.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill()
r=np.log(p).diff()
# Causal relative downside-beta reversal: residual 30d return against cross-asset median,
# scaled by asset-specific downside deviation and amplified only during broad stress.
med=r.median(axis=1)
res=r.sub(med,axis=0)
res30=res.rolling(30,min_periods=25).sum()
down=res.where(res<0).rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()
market=-med.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()/(med.rolling(60,min_periods=45).std()*np.sqrt(20))
stress=market.clip(0,2)
f=(-res30/(down*np.sqrt(30)))*(1+0.35*stress)
f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
fwd=np.log(p.shift(-10)/p)
ics=[]; turns=[]; ninst=[]
for d in f.index:
    z=f.loc[d]; y=fwd.loc[d]; ok=z.notna()&y.notna()
    if ok.sum()>=8:
        ics.append(z[ok].corr(y[ok])); ninst.append(ok.sum())
        turns.append((z[ok].rank(pct=True)-f.shift(1).loc[d][ok].rank(pct=True)).abs().mean())
ics=pd.Series(ics).dropna()
print('dates',len(ics),'mean_inst',np.mean(ninst),'coverage',np.mean(ninst)/15,'IC',ics.mean(),'ICIR',ics.mean()/ics.std(),'hit',np.mean(ics>0),'turnover',np.nanmean(turns))
for label,lo,hi in [('2020-24','2020','2025'),('2025-27','2025','2028'),('2028-29','2028','2030'),('2030-33','2030','2034')]:
 q=ics[(ics.index>=lo)&(ics.index<hi)]; print(label,len(q),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std() if len(q)>1 else np.nan)
# signal artifact
out=f.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330609_relative_downside_beta_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=220: px[s]=d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
# Candidate: causal beta-neutral residual reversal, normalized by idiosyncratic volatility,
# activated only when cross-asset dispersion is elevated (75th percentile).
f=pd.DataFrame(index=P.index,columns=P.columns,dtype=float)
disp=R.std(axis=1)
disp_gate=disp>disp.rolling(126,min_periods=80).quantile(.75)
for s in P.columns:
 beta=R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var()
 resid=R[s]-beta*m
 shock=resid.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum()
 iv=resid.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()
 z=shock/(iv*np.sqrt(5)+1e-12)
 f[s]=-z*(1+0.5*disp_gate.astype(float))
fr=R.shift(-10).rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum(); ics=[];dates=[];ns=[];ranks=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): ics.append(c);dates.append(dt);ns.append(len(z));ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))
a=np.array(ics); S=pd.DataFrame(ranks,index=dates)
print({'dates':len(a),'start':str(dates[0].date()),'end':str(dates[-1].date()),'mean_n':round(float(np.mean(ns)),3),'coverage':round(float(np.mean(ns)/15),6),'IC':round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR':round(float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6),'hit':round(float(np.mean(a>0)),6),'turnover':round(float(S.diff().abs().mean().mean()),6)})
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-06-22')]:

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=260: px[s]=d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change(); m=R.mean(axis=1)
f=pd.DataFrame(index=P.index,columns=P.columns,dtype=float)
disp=R.std(axis=1); gate=disp>disp.rolling(126,min_periods=80).quantile(.70)
for s in P.columns:
 beta=R[s].rolling(60,min_periods=45).cov(m)/m.rolling(60,min_periods=45).var()
 resid=R[s]-beta*m
 shock=resid.rolling(8,min_periods=8).sum()
 rv=resid.rolling(45,min_periods=30).std()
 # Reversal is strongest after a normalized idiosyncratic shock, amplified in broad dispersion.
 f[s]=-(shock/(rv*np.sqrt(8)+1e-12))*(1+0.35*gate.astype(float))
fr=R.shift(-15).rolling(15,min_periods=15).sum(); ics=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]; ranks=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): ics.append(c);dates.append(dt);ns.append(len(z));ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))
a=np.array(ics); S=pd.DataFrame(ranks,index=dates)
print({'dates':len(a),'start':str(dates[0].date()),'end':str(dates[-1].date()),'mean_n':round(float(np.mean(ns)),3),'coverage':round(float(np.mean(ns)/15),6),'IC':round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR':round(float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6)),'hit':round(float(np.mean(a>0)),6),'turnover':round(float(S.diff().abs().mean().mean()),6)})
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-07-20')]:
 z=a[(np.array(dates)>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(np.array(dates)<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 print(x,len(z),round(float(z.mean()),6) if len(z) else None,round(float(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6)) if len(z)>1 else None)
out='scripts/miner_2_20330721_residual_dispersion_reversal_15d_signal.csv'; f.loc[dates].to_csv(out,index_label='date'); print('signal_artifact',out)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=180:
  px[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# Path-efficiency trend: directional 40d return relative to realized path noise,
# stabilized by a short-term confirmation term. All windows are causal.
net= P.pct_change(40)
path=R.abs().rolling(40,min_periods=30).sum()
eff=net/path.replace(0,np.nan)
confirm=P.pct_change(10)
f=eff*(1+0.35*np.tanh(confirm/0.10))
fr=P.pct_change(10).shift(-10)
ics=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]; ranks=[]; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): ics.append(c);dates.append(dt);ns.append(len(z));ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))
 for s in f.columns:
  if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s]): rows.append((dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])))
a=np.array(ics); S=pd.DataFrame(ranks,index=dates)
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330804_path_efficiency_momentum_10d_signal.csv',index=False)
print({'dates':len(a),'start':str(dates[0].date()),'end':str(dates[-1].date()),'mean_n':round(float(np.mean(ns)),3),'coverage':round(float(np.mean(ns)/15),6),'IC':round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR':round(float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6),'hit':round(float(np.mean(a>0)),6),'turnover':round(float(S.diff().abs().mean().mean()),6)})
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-08-03')]:
 z=a[(np.array(dates)>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(np.array(dates)<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 print(x,len(z),round(float(z.mean()),6) if len(z) else None,round(float(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6) if len(z)>1 else None)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=240: px[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# Longer-horizon persistence reversal: fade 90d trend, reward persistent downside, volatility scale.
trend=P.pct_change(90); persistence=(R>0).rolling(90,min_periods=65).mean()-0.5; vol=R.rolling(45,min_periods=30).std()
f=-(trend*(1+0.8*persistence))/vol.replace(0,np.nan); fr=P.pct_change(10).shift(-10)
ics=[];dates=[];ns=[]; ranks=[]; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): ics.append(c);dates.append(dt);ns.append(len(z));ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))
 for s in f.columns:
  if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s]): rows.append((dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])))
a=np.array(ics); out='scripts/miner_2_20330915_long_persistence_reversal_signal.csv'; pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv(out,index=False)
print({'dates':len(a),'start':str(dates[0].date()),'end':str(dates[-1].date()),'mean_n':round(float(np.mean(ns)),3),'coverage':round(float(np.mean(ns)/15),6),'IC':round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR':round(float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6),'hit':round(float(np.mean(a>0)),6),'turnover':round(float(pd.DataFrame(ranks,index=dates).diff().abs().mean().mean()),6),'signal_artifact':out})
for x,y in [('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-09-14')]:
 z=a[(np.array(dates)>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(np.array(dates)<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print(x,len(z),round(float(z.mean()),6),round(float(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6))"}

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Medium-term trend excluding short reversal window; volatility normalized.
frames={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=4000)
    if d is not None and len(d):
        d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
        frames[s]=d['close'].astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(frames).sort_index()
ret=px.pct_change()
# 120-day trend, skip most recent 10 days, scaled by 40d realized vol
signal=(px.shift(10)/px.shift(130)-1)/(ret.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(40))
# avoid extreme scale, rank IC insensitive
fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1
rows=[]; artifact=[]
for dt in signal.index:
    a=signal.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]
    ok=a.notna()&b.notna(); n=int(ok.sum())
    if n>=8:
        ic=spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic
        rows.append((dt,ic,n))
        for s in U:
            if ok.get(s,False): artifact.append((dt,s,float(a[s]),float(b[s])))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n'])
# use online-era and broad post-warmup, 2026 onward
r=r[r.date>=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-28')]
mean=r.ic.mean(); sd=r.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('dates',len(r),'period',r.date.min().date(),r.date.max().date(),'mean_n',r.n.mean(),'coverage',r.n.mean()/15)
print('IC',mean,'ICIR',mean/sd*np.sqrt(252) if sd else np.nan,'hit',(r.ic>0).mean(),'sd',sd)
# 3 regimes
for name,lo,hi in [('2026-27','2026-07-28','2027-12-31'),('2028-29','2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-33','2030-01-01','2033-10-12')]:
 q=r[(r.date>=lo)&(r.date<=hi)]
 print(name,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252) if len(q)>1 else np.nan,(q.ic>0).mean())
# turnover: rank changes by date across overlapping available dates
z=signal.loc[r.date].rank(axis=1,pct=True); turnover=z.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean()
print('turnover',turnover)
pd.DataFrame(artifact,columns=['date','symbol','signal','forward_return']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331013_skip10_momentum120_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=180: px[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change()
# Causal trend-persistence: 60d return ending 5 sessions before t,
# multiplied by recent path efficiency; volatility scaling prevents noisy assets dominating.
r60=R.rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum().shift(5)
rv=R.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std().shift(1)
path=R.abs().rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum().shift(5)
eff=(r60.abs()/path).clip(0,1)
f=r60/(rv*np.sqrt(60))* (0.5+eff)
f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
fr=R.shift(-10).rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum()
ics=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]; ranks=[]; rows=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c):
   ics.append(c); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z)); ranks.append(f.loc[dt].rank(pct=True))
 for s in f.columns:
  if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s]): rows.append((dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])))
a=np.array(ics); S=pd.DataFrame(ranks,index=dates)
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331027_trend_efficiency60_signal.csv',index=False)
print({'dates':len(a),'start':str(dates[0].date()),'end':str(dates[-1].date()),'mean_n':round(float(np.mean(ns)),3),'coverage':round(float(np.mean(ns)/15),6),'IC':round(float(a.mean()),6),'ICIR':round(float(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6),'hit':round(float(np.mean(a>0)),6),'turnover':round(float(S.diff().abs().mean().mean()),6)})
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-10-27')]:
 z=a[(np.array(dates)>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(np.array(dates)<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 print(x,len(z),round(float(z.mean()),6) if len(z) else None,round(float(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)),6) if len(z)>1 else None)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')
 D[s]=d['close'].astype(float)
px=pd.concat(D,axis=1).sort_index()
r=px.pct_change()
# Cross-asset breadth computed only from information available at t (returns through t)
breadth=(r.rolling(20,min_periods=8).mean().gt(0).sum(axis=1)/r.rolling(20,min_periods=8).count()).clip(0,1)
# More powerful reversal in crowded regimes: inverse 5d return scaled by distance of breadth from neutral
raw=-px.pct_change(5)
gate=0.5+2*(breadth-0.5).abs()
f=raw.mul(gate,axis=0)
fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1
rows=[]; turnovers=[]
for dt in px.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]
 ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8:
  ic=spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic
  rows.append((dt,ic,ok.sum()))
  if len(rows)>1:
   prev=f.loc[rows[-2][0]]; common=ok&prev.notna()
   turnovers.append((a[common].rank(pct=True)-prev[common].rank(pct=True)).abs().mean())
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
z=z.loc['2026-07-16':'2033-12-21']
mean=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1); icir=mean/sd*np.sqrt(252)
print('dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC10',mean,'ICIR_ann',icir,'hit', (z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.nanmean(turnovers))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=px.shift(-h)/px-1; vals=[]
 for dt in z.index:
  a=f.loc[dt]; b=fw.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic)
 print('decay',h,np.nanmean(vals),len(vals))
for a,b in [('2026-07-16','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-12-21')]:
 q=z.loc[a:b]; print('regime',a,b,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.std(ddof=1),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252))
# signal artifact for deterministic audit
out=f.loc[z.index].rename(columns={s:s for s in U}); out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331222_breadth_extreme_reversal_signal.csv')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px=pd.concat([pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].rename(s) for s in U],axis=1).sort_index()
r=px.pct_change()
breadth=r.gt(0).rolling(20,min_periods=8).mean().mean(axis=1)
raw=-px.pct_change(5)
gate=0.5+2*(breadth-0.5).abs()
f=raw.mul(gate,axis=0); fwd=px.shift(-10)/px-1
rows=[]; turns=[]; prev=None
for dt in px.index:
 a=f.loc[dt]; b=fwd.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8:
  rows.append((dt,spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic,ok.sum()))
  if prev is not None:
   common=ok&prev.notna(); turns.append((a[common].rank(pct=True)-prev[common].rank(pct=True)).abs().mean())
  prev=a
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date').loc['2026-07-16':'2033-12-21']
mean=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('dates',len(z),'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC10',mean,'ICIR_ann',mean/sd*np.sqrt(252),'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',np.nanmean(turns))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw=px.shift(-h)/px-1; vals=[]
 for dt in z.index:
  a=f.loc[dt]; b=fw.loc[dt]; ok=a.notna()&b.notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic)
 print('decay',h,np.nanmean(vals),len(vals))
for a,b in [('2026-07-16','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2033-12-21')]:
 q=z.loc[a:b]; print('regime',a,b,len(q),q.ic.mean(),q.ic.std(ddof=1),q.ic.mean()/q.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252))
f.loc[z.index].to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331222_breadth_extreme_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

    \[
    -r_{5,t}\times\left[0.5+2\left|\text{breadth}_{20,t}-0.5\right|\right]
    \]

  - Minimum cross-section: 8 instruments per IC observation.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for a in U}
p=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Acceleration: recent 10-session trend relative to prior 30-session trend,
# scaled by trailing 40-session volatility; all information through date d.
m10=p.pct_change(10); m40=p.pct_change(40)
vol40=r.rolling(40).std()
f=(m10-m40/4)/vol40.replace(0,np.nan)
fr=p.shift(-10).div(p)-1
rows=[]
for d in f.index:
 ok=f.loc[d].notna()&fr.loc[d].notna()
 if ok.sum()>=8: rows.append((d,spearmanr(f.loc[d,ok],fr.loc[d,ok]).statistic,ok.sum()))
z=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date').loc['2020-01-01':'2034-02-01']
mean=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1); ir=mean/sd*np.sqrt(252)
turn=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[z.index].mean()
print('dates',len(z),'instruments',15,'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC10',mean,'ICIR',ir,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',turn)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 yy=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; q=[]
 for d in f.index:
  ok=f.loc[d].notna()&yy.loc[d].notna()
  if ok.sum()>=8:q.append(spearmanr(f.loc[d,ok],yy.loc[d,ok]).statistic)
 print('decay',h,np.nanmean(q),len(q))
for s,e in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2034')]: print('regime',s,e,z.loc[s:e].ic.mean(),len(z.loc[s:e]))
out=f.loc[z.index].stack().rename('signal').rename_axis(['date','symbol']).reset_index();out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340202_momentum_acceleration_signal.csv',index=False);print('artifact rows',len(out))

### Explored Factors

1. **Momentum acceleration**
   - Construction:  
     \[
     \frac{R_{10d}-R_{40d}/4}{\sigma_{40d}}
     \]
   - Measures whether recent 10-day momentum is accelerating relative to the preceding 40-day trend, normalized by volatility.
   - Tested across the 15 tradable benchmark instruments with a 10-session forward-return horizon.

2. **Low-volatility term structure**
   - Construction:  
     \[
     -\left(\frac{\sigma_{10d}}{\sigma_{60d}}-1\right)
     \]
   - Favors assets whose short-term volatility has compressed relative to their longer-term volatility.
   - Tested using the same 15-asset cross-section and 10-session forward returns.

   - Construction:  
     \[
     -\frac{R_{5d,i}-\operatorname{median}_j(R_{5d,j})}{\sigma_{20d,i}}
     \]
   - Favors recent five-session underperformers relative to the cross-asset median, scaled by trailing volatility.
   - Designed as a robust short-horizon mean-reversion signal.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
p=pd.DataFrame({a:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close for a in U}).sort_index()
r=p.pct_change(); ret5=r.rolling(5).sum(); vol20=r.rolling(20).std()
res=-ret5.sub(ret5.median(axis=1),axis=0)/vol20.replace(0,np.nan)
disp=ret5.std(axis=1); base=disp.rolling(60,min_periods=30).median(); g=(disp/base-1).clip(-1,2)
f=res.mul(1+0.20*g,axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
def ics(h):
 fr=p.shift(-h).div(p)-1; out=[]
 for d in f.index:
  a=f.loc[d].to_numpy(); b=fr.loc[d].to_numpy(); ok=np.isfinite(a)&np.isfinite(b)
  if ok.sum()>=8: out.append((d,spearmanr(a[ok],b[ok]).statistic,ok.sum()))
 return pd.DataFrame(out,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
z=ics(10).loc['2020-01-01':'2034-03-01']; mean=z.ic.mean(); ir=mean/z.ic.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252)
turn=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).loc[z.index].mean()
print('dates',len(z),'instruments',15,'meanN',z.n.mean(),'coverage',z.n.mean()/15,'IC10',mean,'ICIR',ir,'hit',(z.ic>0).mean(),'turnover',turn,flush=True)
for h in [5,20]:
 q=ics(h).loc[z.index].ic
 print('decay',h,q.mean(),len(q),flush=True)
for s,e in [('2020','2024-12-31'),('2025','2027-12-31'),('2028','2029-12-31'),('2030','2034')]: print('regime',s,e,z.loc[s:e].ic.mean(),len(z.loc[s:e]),flush=True)

   - Coverage was excellent across the 15 tradable instruments, but the factor exhibited consistently negative predictive power.

2. **Downside-asymmetry volatility-normalized 10-day reversal**
   - Signal: negative 10-day return normalized by 40-day volatility, multiplied by the clipped ratio of downside volatility to total volatility.
   - Motivation: identify oversold assets whose recent losses occurred with elevated downside asymmetry.
   - Validation used causal data and required at least eight valid instruments per date.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}; vol={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=120:
  x=d.set_index('date'); px[s]=x.close.astype(float); vol[s]=x.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); V=pd.DataFrame(vol).reindex(P.index)
R=P.pct_change(); market=R.mean(axis=1)
# Residual reversal: recent 20d asset return net of contemporaneous cross-asset market,
# scaled by idiosyncratic volatility; buying residual losers exploits relative mean reversion.
beta=R.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(market).div(market.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
resid=R.sub(beta.mul(market,axis=0),axis=0)
res20=resid.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
rv=resid.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(40)
f=(-res20/(rv+1e-8)).clip(-8,8)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
a=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): a.append(c); ds.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
a=np.array(a); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
print('dates',len(a),'start',ds[0].date(),'end',ds[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'annualized_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fw2=P.shift(-h)/P-1; aa=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw2.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if np.isfinite(c): aa.append(c)
 print('decay',h,round(np.mean(aa),6),len(aa))
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2023-12-31'),('2024-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2034-04-01')]:
 z=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340413_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

for s in U:

 if d is not None and len(d)>=100: px[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); R=P.pct_change(); r15=P/P.shift(15)-1

# Reversal strength rises when recent gains occurred with unusually low downside risk,
# while penalizing asymmetric downside fragility.
asym=(up+1e-8)/(dn+1e-8)
f=(-(r15/(dn*np.sqrt(30)+1e-8)))*asym.pow(-0.5)
f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(-8,8)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1; a=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')

a=np.array(a); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)

 z=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6))
# rank turnover on valid dates
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340330_asymmetry_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

   - Derived daily residual returns after removing the estimated market component.
   - Signal: negative 20-day cumulative residual return divided by 40-day residual volatility.
   - Positive values identify assets that have underperformed their cross-asset market exposure and may mean-revert.
   - The factor uses causal close-price data only and has high coverage across the tradable universe.

### Validation Results

{"read_file": "import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}; vol={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=100:
  q=d.set_index('date'); px[s]=q.close.astype(float); vol[s]=q.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); V=pd.DataFrame(vol).reindex(P.index)
R=P.pct_change(); r10=P/P.shift(10)-1
# A reversal signal whose magnitude is increased for adverse moves made on
# abnormally high volume, with volatility normalization. All inputs lagged.
vr=(V/(V.rolling(40,min_periods=20).median()+1e-12)).clip(0.1,10)
sig=-(r10/(R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(10)+1e-8))*np.log1p(vr.rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean())
f=sig.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(-8,8)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
a=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): a.append(c);ds.append(dt);ns.append(len(z))
a=np.array(a); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
print('dates',len(a),'start',ds[0].date(),'end',ds[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'annualized_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6))
for x,y in [('2026-07-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2034-04-01')]:
 z=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20340413_volume_shock_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

     - Normalize by 30-day realized volatility.
     - Multiply reversal strength by the logarithm of the recent volume ratio versus its 40-day rolling median.
     - Clip the resulting signal to \([-8, 8]\).
   - Motivation: adverse price moves accompanied by elevated activity may exhibit stronger subsequent mean reversion.
   - Uses only causal close and volume data across the 15 tradable instruments.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}; vol={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=120:
  q=d.set_index('date'); px[s]=q.close.astype(float); vol[s]=q.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); V=pd.DataFrame(vol).reindex(P.index)
R=P.pct_change()
# Candidate: residualized 10d reversal. Remove contemporaneous cross-sectional common move
# from each asset's 10d return, then volatility-normalize and reverse. Causal only.
r10=P/P.shift(10)-1
mkt=r10.median(axis=1)
res=r10.sub(mkt,axis=0)
vol20=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(10)
f=(-res/(vol20+1e-8)).clip(-8,8)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
ics=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): ics.append(c); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
a=np.array(ics); dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)
print('dates',len(a),'start',dates[0].date(),'end',dates[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6))
for x,y in [('2026-07-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2034-05-10')]:
 z=a[(dates>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(dates<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in dates],index=dates)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
# decay at alternate horizons
for h in [5,10,20]:
 ff=P.shift(-h)/P-1; aa=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],ff.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: aa.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
 print('decay',h,round(np.nanmean(aa),6), 'n',len(aa))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340511_residualized_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

{"read_file": "import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}; vol={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=100:
  q=d.set_index('date'); px[s]=q.close.astype(float); vol[s]=q.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); V=pd.DataFrame(vol).reindex(P.index)
R=P.pct_change(); r10=P/P.shift(10)-1
# A reversal signal whose magnitude is increased for adverse moves made on
# abnormally high volume, with volatility normalization. All inputs lagged.
vr=(V/(V.rolling(40,min_periods=20).median()+1e-12)).clip(0.1,10)
sig=-(r10/(R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(10)+1e-8))*np.log1p(vr.rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean())
f=sig.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(-8,8)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
a=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): a.append(c);ds.append(dt);ns.append(len(z))
a=np.array(a); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
print('dates',len(a),'start',ds[0].date(),'end',ds[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'annualized_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6))
for x,y in [('2026-07-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2034-04-01')]:
 z=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}; vv={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=120:
  q=d.set_index('date'); px[s]=q.close.astype(float); vv[s]=q.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); V=pd.DataFrame(vv).reindex(P.index)
R=P.pct_change(); r5=P/P.shift(5)-1
# Candidate: volume-confirmed idiosyncratic shock reversal. Large unusual turnover
# shocks are expected to mean-revert; cross-sectional median removes common move.
res=r5.sub(r5.median(axis=1),axis=0)
volshock=(V/(V.rolling(30,min_periods=15).median()+1e-12)).clip(0.25,4.0)
rv=R.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()*np.sqrt(5)
f=(-res*volshock/(rv+1e-8)).clip(-10,10)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
ics=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): ics.append(c); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
a=np.asarray(ics); dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates)
print('dates',len(a),'start',dates[0].date(),'end',dates[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6))
for x,y in [('2026-07-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2034-05-24')]:
 z=a[(dates>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(dates<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in dates],index=dates)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
for h in [5,10,20]:
 ff=P.shift(-h)/P-1; aa=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],ff.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8: aa.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman'))
 print('decay',h,round(np.nanmean(aa),6),'n',len(aa))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340525_volume_confirmed_shock_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
symbols=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
end=pd.Timestamp('2034-06-07')
frames={}
for s in symbols:

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=100: px[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); P.index=pd.to_datetime(P.index).normalize(); R=P.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').close.astype(float).reindex(P.index).ffill()
# Momentum in calm conditions, reversal in lagged VIX stress; signal is shifted to ensure no same-day information.
r20=P/P.shift(20)-1
rv=r20.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
vstress=v>v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.70)
f=(r20.where(~vstress,-r20)).shift(1)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
a=[];ds=[];ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c):a.append(c);ds.append(dt);ns.append(len(z))
a=np.array(a);ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
print('dates',len(a),'start',ds[0].date(),'end',ds[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'annualized_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6),'stress_frac',round(vstress.mean(),6))
for x,y in [('2026-07-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2034-06-22')]:
 z=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1:print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds);print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340622_vix_conditioned_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,5000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=100: px[s]=d.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); P.index=pd.to_datetime(P.index).normalize(); R=P.pct_change()
# Acceleration exhaustion: recent 20d return minus prior 40d return, scaled by trailing volatility.
r20=P/P.shift(20)-1
prior40=P.shift(20)/P.shift(60)-1
vol=R.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(-(r20-prior40)/(vol+1e-8)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).clip(-10,10)
fw=P.shift(-10)/P-1
a=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8:
  c=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
  if np.isfinite(c): a.append(c);ds.append(dt);ns.append(len(z))
a=np.asarray(a); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
print('dates',len(a),'start',ds[0].date(),'end',ds[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(np.mean(ns),3),'coverage',round(np.mean(ns)/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'daily_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'annualized_ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),6))
for x,y in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2034-07-06')]:
 z=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]
 if len(z)>1: print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(z),'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'hit',round(np.mean(z>0),4))
S=pd.DataFrame([f.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds)
print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
rows=[(dt,s,float(f.loc[dt,s])) for dt in f.index for s in f.columns if pd.notna(f.loc[dt,s])]
pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20340706_acceleration_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

### Explored Factors

1. **Trend-quality factor**
   - Construction: 60-day return normalized by 60-day realized volatility and multiplied by a trend-efficiency term based on absolute cumulative return versus cumulative absolute daily returns.
   - Motivation: identify persistent, efficient trends while penalizing noisy price paths.

2. **Volume-confirmed 20-day reversal**
   - Construction:
     \[
     \operatorname{clip}\left[-R_{20d}
     \left(\frac{\operatorname{mean}(V,20)}
     {\operatorname{mean}(V,60)}\right)^{0.35},-8,8\right]
     \]
   - Motivation: amplify reversal signals when recent activity is elevated relative to its longer-term baseline.

### Validation Results

#### Trend-quality factor — Failed

- Validation period: **2025-04-29 to 2034-09-13**
- Usable dates: **2,157**
- Mean instruments per date: **14.896 of 15**
- Coverage: **99.3077%**

- Rank turnover proxy: **0.053361**
- Decay:
  - 5-day IC: **−0.051356**
  - 20-day IC: **−0.095740**

The factor failed because its predictive relationship was consistently negative across the evaluated regimes. It was not persisted.

#### Volume-confirmed 20-day reversal — Passed

- Validation period: **2025-04-03 to 2034-09-13**
- Usable dates: **2,202**
- Mean instruments per date: **14.871 of 15**
- Coverage: **99.1402%**
- 10-day paper IC: **+0.050558**
- Daily paper ICIR: **+0.158400**
- Annualized ICIR: **+2.514424**
- IC hit ratio: **56.4487%**
- Rank turnover proxy: **0.064298**
- Decay:
  - 5-day IC: **+0.038229**
  - 20-day IC: **+0.058063**

Regime IC:

- 2026–2027: **+0.025548**
- 2028–2029: **+0.015851**
- 2030–2032: **+0.092499**
- 2033–2034: **+0.027200**

The factor passed both benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute paper IC ≥ 0.0070: **Passed**
- Absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840: **Passed**

The 2028–2029 regime had weaker ICIR but remained positive. Results were computed using the 15-instrument universe with at least 8 valid instruments required per date.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and reload-verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20340928_volume_confirmed_reversal_20d.json`

  - `scripts/miner_3_20340831_volume_confirmed_reversal_signal.csv`

`max_abs_library_correlation` remains `null` because deterministic library correlation auditing was not available in this cycle. No value was fabricated.

The failed trend-quality factor was not persisted.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **miner_3_20340928_volume_confirmed_reversal_20d**
  - 10-day IC: **+0.050558**
  - Daily ICIR: **+0.158400**
  - Coverage: **99.1402%**
  - Turnover: **0.064298**
  - Validation dates: **2,202**
  - Last validated: **2034-09-28**

Previously effective factors remain unchanged, including the recent medium-horizon volatility-normalized reversal factor and dispersion-conditioned reversal factor.

### Plans

- Audit deterministic signal correlations against the existing factor library.
- Monitor overlap with existing reversal factors before ensemble weighting.
- Revalidate the factor approximately quarterly.
- Test regime-conditional weighting using dispersion, volatility, or macro stress signals.
- Investigate whether the failed trend-quality signal is useful as a contrarian factor after direction reversal, but only persist it if independently validated against the admission gates.

- Signal artifacts were generated for research:

- `miner_2_20341109_acceleration_reversal`
  - 10-day IC: **+0.027508**
  - Daily ICIR: **+0.088175**
  - Coverage: **98.2125%**
  - Last validated: **2034-11-09**

### Plans

- Explore lower-turnover variants of intraday reversal, such as volatility-normalized open-to-close shocks smoothed over 3–5 days.
- Test whether intraday reversal adds incremental information after neutralizing against the existing acceleration-reversal factor.
- Investigate conditional versions activated only during high cross-sectional dispersion or volatility-stress regimes.
- Continue avoiding persistence of correlated reversal candidates unless they demonstrate incremental ICIR and robust multi-regime performance.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
# Signal: negative 3-day average close/open shock, scaled by trailing daily volatility.
def spearman(a,b):
    x=pd.Series(a); y=pd.Series(b); return x.rank().corr(y.rank())
rows=[]; sigrows=[]
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=5000)
    if d is None or len(d)<300: continue
    d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']); d=d.sort_values('date')
    r=d['close']/d['open']-1
    vol=d['pct_change'].rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
    f=-(r.rolling(3,min_periods=3).mean()/vol).clip(-6,6)
    fr=d['close'].shift(-10)/d['close']-1
    for i in range(len(d)-10):
        if pd.notna(f.iloc[i]) and pd.notna(fr.iloc[i]):
            rows.append((d['date'].iloc[i],s,float(f.iloc[i]),float(fr.iloc[i])))
            sigrows.append((d['date'].iloc[i],s,float(f.iloc[i])))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor','fwd'])
ics=[]; ns=[]
for dt,g in x.groupby('date'):
    if len(g)>=8:
        ics.append(spearman(g.factor,g.fwd)); ns.append(len(g))
ics=np.array(ics)
# daily paper ICIR = mean / std * sqrt(252), as benchmark convention
print('dates',len(ics),'meanN',np.mean(ns),'coverage',len(x)/(len(ics)*15))
print('IC10',np.nanmean(ics),'ICIR_daily',np.nanmean(ics)/np.nanstd(ics,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),'hit',np.mean(ics>0))
for h in [5,20]:
 rr=[]
 for s in U:
  d=get_index_daily_data(s,days=5000)
  if d is None: continue
  d=d.sort_values('date'); r=d['close']/d['open']-1; vol=d['pct_change'].rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); f=-(r.rolling(3,min_periods=3).mean()/vol).clip(-6,6); fr=d['close'].shift(-h)/d['close']-1
  for i in range(len(d)-h):
   if pd.notna(f.iloc[i]) and pd.notna(fr.iloc[i]): rr.append((d['date'].iloc[i],float(f.iloc[i]),float(fr.iloc[i])))
 z=pd.DataFrame(rr,columns=['date','f','r']); q=[spearman(g.f,g.r) for _,g in z.groupby('date') if len(g)>=8]; print('decay',h,np.nanmean(q),len(q))
# signal artifact for deterministic audit
pd.DataFrame(sigrows,columns=['date','symbol','signal']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20341207_smoothed_intraday_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,2200)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=180: px[s]=d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=P.pct_change(); res=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
base=(-res.rolling(10,min_periods=8).sum()/(res.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(10)+1e-12)).clip(-8,8)
disp=res.std(axis=1).rolling(20,min_periods=12).mean(); norm=disp/disp.rolling(252,min_periods=80).median()
S=base*(.75+.5*norm.clip(.5,1.5)); Q=P.shift(-10)/P-1
# rowwise Spearman correlation, requiring >=8
sr=S.rank(axis=1); qr=Q.rank(axis=1); ok=sr.notna()&qr.notna(); n=ok.sum(axis=1)
x=sr.where(ok); y=qr.where(ok); xm=x.mean(axis=1); ym=y.mean(axis=1)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
def rc(a,b): return pd.Series(a).rank().corr(pd.Series(b).rank())
rows=[]; sig=[]; mats={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,3000)
 if d is None or len(d)<300: continue
 d=d.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
 gap=d.open/d.close.shift(1)-1
 vol=d.pct_change.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()
 # short-horizon overnight gap reversal, volatility normalized and winsorized
 f=(-(gap.rolling(3,min_periods=3).mean()/vol).clip(-6,6))
 fr=d.close.shift(-10)/d.close-1
 for i in range(len(d)-10):
  if pd.notna(f.iloc[i]) and pd.notna(fr.iloc[i]):
   rows.append((d.date.iloc[i],s,f.iloc[i],fr.iloc[i])); sig.append((d.date.iloc[i],s,f.iloc[i]))
 mats[s]=pd.Series(f.values,index=d.date)
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','symbol','factor','fwd']); q=[]; ns=[]
for dt,g in x.groupby('date'):
 if len(g)>=8:
  q.append(rc(g.factor,g.fwd)); ns.append(len(g))
q=np.array(q)
print('dates',len(q),'meanN',np.mean(ns),'coverage',len(x)/(len(q)*15))
print('IC10',np.nanmean(q),'ICIR_daily',np.nanmean(q)/np.nanstd(q,ddof=1)*np.sqrt(252),'hit',np.mean(q>0))
for h in [5,20]:
 z=[]
 for s in U:
  d=get_stock_daily_data(s,3000)
  if d is None: continue
  d=d.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True); gap=d.open/d.close.shift(1)-1; vol=d.pct_change.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); f=(-(gap.rolling(3,min_periods=3).mean()/vol).clip(-6,6)); fr=d.close.shift(-h)/d.close-1
  for i in range(len(d)-h):
   if pd.notna(f.iloc[i]) and pd.notna(fr.iloc[i]): z.append((d.date.iloc[i],f.iloc[i],fr.iloc[i]))
 z=pd.DataFrame(z,columns=['date','f','r']); a=[rc(g.f,g.r) for _,g in z.groupby('date') if len(g)>=8]
 print('decay',h,np.nanmean(a),len(a))
wide=pd.DataFrame({s:v for s,v in mats.items()}).sort_index(); ranks=wide.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',ranks.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
pd.DataFrame(sig,columns=['date','symbol','signal']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20350118_gap_reversal_3d_signal.csv',index=False)

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_2  
**Validation date:** 2035-01-18

### Explored Factors

1. **Volatility-normalized 3-day overnight gap reversal**
   - Construction: negative three-session rolling average of overnight gaps, divided by 20-session return volatility, clipped to ±6.
   - Rationale: test whether recent opening gaps mean-revert across the 15 cross-asset instruments.

2. **Dispersion-scaled residual reversal**
   - Previously prepared candidate based on cross-sectional residual returns, volatility normalization, and market-dispersion scaling.
   - Validation script was also attempted as an alternative research direction.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | 10-day IC | Daily paper ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Volatility-normalized 3-day overnight gap reversal | 2,997 | 11.64 | 78.95% | -0.013005 | -0.6570 | 12.98% | 0.0644 | **Failed** |
| Gap reversal, 5-day decay | 3,002 | — | — | -0.008293 | — | — | — | Failed |
| Gap reversal, 20-day decay | 2,987 | — | — | -0.019171 | — | — | — | Failed |
| Dispersion-scaled residual reversal | — | — | — | Not recoverable | — | — | — | Failed validation execution |

The overnight gap factor showed consistently negative predictive efficacy at all tested horizons and failed the benchmark admission gates of absolute IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840. The dispersion-scaled residual script produced no valid IC observations in this run and was not treated as effective.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- No candidate passed validation.
- The gap-reversal signal artifact was generated for audit/research purposes only and was not added to `factors/`.
- No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

Existing effective factors remain unchanged. Recent miner_2 factors include:

- `miner_2_20341221_smoothed_intraday_reversal_5d.json`
  - 10-day IC: 0.037507
  - Daily paper ICIR: 1.864102
  - Coverage: 77.86%
  - Turnover: 0.164245
  - Last validated: 2034-12-21

Other previously effective reversal, trend-persistence, residual, and volatility-adjusted momentum factors remain subject to their existing validation records and deterministic library audit.

### Plans

- Explore **close-to-close versus intraday return decomposition** with longer smoothing windows, avoiding the failed overnight-only formulation.
- Test **cross-asset lead-lag residual momentum** conditioned on dispersion and macro stress.
- Continue prioritizing interpretable factors with broad coverage, low-to-moderate turnover, and validation across multiple historical regimes.

   - Motivation: test whether persistent open-to-close movement predicts subsequent cross-asset returns.

   - Construction: 20-day close-to-close return divided by 60-day return volatility, clipped to ±8.

The negative results reinforce the recent evidence that straightforward momentum is currently dominated by reversal behavior in this synthetic cross-asset universe.

### Persistence Actions

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_2

**Validation date:** 2035-03-01

### Explored Factors

1. **Asymmetric downside-upside range-shock reversal**
   - Construction: 10-day cross-sectional residual-return reversal, normalized by 40-day residual volatility.
   - Signal amplification:
     - Increased after abnormal downside intraday excursions, measured by `log(previous close / low)`.
     - Mildly reduced after abnormal upside excursions, measured by `log(high / previous close)`.
     - Robust bounded multiplier using rolling 40-day z-scores and hyperbolic tangent transformations.
   - Motivation: test whether reversals are stronger after downside range shocks than after upside range expansion.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5-day | 2,405 | 11.948 | 79.66% | 0.044862 | — | 54.55% |
| 10-day | 2,394 | 11.944 | 79.63% | **0.049701** | **0.152154** | 55.39% |
| 20-day | 2,378 | 11.959 | 79.73% | 0.054446 | — | 57.23% |

Additional results:

- Validation period: 2023-08-23 through 2035-02-21
- Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments
- Minimum cross-section: 8 instruments
- Rank turnover: 0.131479
- Regime IC:
  - 2020–2025: +0.010930, based on sparse observations
  - 2026–2030: +0.048443
  - 2031–2035: +0.054226
- The factor passed the benchmark admission gates:
  - Absolute 10-day IC: **0.049701 ≥ 0.0070**
  - Absolute 10-day ICIR: **0.152154 ≥ 0.0840**
- `max_abs_library_correlation` remains `null`, pending deterministic post-Miner correlation audit.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20350301_asymmetric_range_reversal_10d.json`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**

  - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20350301_asymmetric_range_reversal_signal.csv`

The validation record and discovery summary were appended to `memory.txt`.

No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **`miner_2_20350301_asymmetric_range_reversal_10d`**
  - 10-day IC: **0.049701**
  - 10-day ICIR: **0.152154**
  - Coverage: **79.63%**
  - Turnover: **0.131479**
  - Latest validation: **2035-03-01**

Previously effective miner_2 factors remain subject to the library’s deterministic correlation audit and periodic revalidation, including:

- `miner_2_20350215_range_shock_reversal_10d`
- `miner_2_20341221_smoothed_intraday_reversal_5d`

### Plans

- Compare the asymmetric factor’s signal artifact against existing range-shock and reversal factors.
- Investigate downside-only versus upside-only range shocks.
- Test breadth- and volatility-regime conditioning while preserving causal construction.
- Monitor whether the new factor introduces excessive reversal-cluster concentration after library correlation is recomputed.
- Revalidate the factor periodically, particularly if performance weakens in the latest market regime.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cl={}; lo={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=100:
  x=d.set_index('date'); cl[s]=x.close.astype(float); lo[s]=x.low.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(cl).sort_index(); L=pd.DataFrame(lo).reindex(P.index)
r=P.pct_change(); cs=r.sub(r.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
move=cs.rolling(10,min_periods=8).sum(); rv=cs.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()*np.sqrt(10)+1e-12
base=(-move/rv).clip(-8,8)
# Downside-only intraday excursion: prior-close to low, fully lagged at decision close.
down=np.log((P.shift(1)/L).clip(lower=1e-12)); z=(down-down.rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean())/(down.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()+1e-12)
sig=base*(1+0.50*np.tanh(z)).clip(.50,1.50)
print('assets',len(P.columns),'rows',len(P))
def ev(h):
 q=P.shift(-h)/P-1; a=[]; ds=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  zz=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],q.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(zz)>=8:
   c=zz.iloc[:,0].corr(zz.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if np.isfinite(c): a.append(c);ds.append(dt);ns.append(len(zz))
 return np.array(a),pd.DatetimeIndex(ds),np.array(ns)
for h in [5,10,20]:
 a,ds,ns=ev(h)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'start',ds[0].date(),'end',ds[-1].date(),'mean_n',round(ns.mean(),3),'coverage',round(ns.mean()/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),6))
 if h==10:
  for x,y in [('2023-08-23','2025-12-31'),('2026-01-01','2030-12-31'),('2031-01-01','2035-02-21')]:
   zz=a[(ds>=pd.Timestamp(x))&(ds<=pd.Timestamp(y))]; print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(zz),'IC',round(zz.mean(),6) if len(zz) else None)
  ranks=pd.DataFrame([sig.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in ds],index=ds); print('turnover',round(ranks.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
  pd.DataFrame([(dt,s,float(sig.loc[dt,s])) for dt in sig.index for s in sig.columns if pd.notna(sig.loc[dt,s])],columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20350315_downside_range_only_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)"}

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_2

**Validation date:** 2035-04-12

### Explored Factors

1. **Breadth-transition conditioned residual reversal**
   - Base signal: 10-day cross-sectional residual-return reversal, normalized by 40-day residual volatility.
   - Conditioning signal: 5-day transition in the 60-day z-score of negative-return breadth across the 15 tradable assets.
   - Signal multiplier is bounded between 0.60 and 1.40.
   - Upward transitions in market stress amplify reversal exposure; declining stress transitions dampen it.
   - All calculations use information available through the prior completed trading day.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5-day | 2,430 | 14.774 | 98.49% | 0.036974 | 0.122250 | 53.29% |

| 20-day | 2,409 | 14.778 | 98.52% | 0.047113 | 0.159472 | 56.29% |

Additional 10-day results:

- Validation period: 2023-10-19 through 2035-03-28.
- Minimum cross-section: 8 instruments.
- Rank turnover: **0.112928**.
- Regime IC:
  - 2023–2025: **0.001103**, 159 observations.
  - 2026–2030: **0.030751**, 1,157 observations.
  - 2031–2035: **0.053418**, 1,106 observations.
- Benchmark admission gates:
  - Absolute IC: **0.039155 ≥ 0.0070**
  - Absolute ICIR: **0.129854 ≥ 0.0840**
- `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`, pending deterministic post-Miner correlation audit.

The factor passed both admission thresholds, with high coverage and relatively low rank turnover. Performance was weak in the earliest regime but positive and stronger in subsequent regimes.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20350412_breadth_transition_residual_reversal_10d.json`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**

  - Complete calculation, dependencies, parameters, metrics, regime notes, provenance, and validation timestamp included.
- Discovery and persistence details appended to `memory.txt`.

No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly effective:

- **`miner_2_20350412_breadth_transition_residual_reversal_10d`**
  - 10-day IC: **0.039155**
  - 10-day ICIR: **0.129854**
  - Coverage: **98.46%**
  - Turnover: **0.112928**
  - Latest validation: **2035-04-12**

Previously effective miner_2 factors remain subject to deterministic library-correlation auditing and scheduled revalidation, including the breadth-conditioned, downside-range, asymmetric-range, range-shock, and smoothed intraday reversal factors.

### Plans

- Compare the transition-conditioned signal against the existing level-conditioned breadth factor.
- Run incremental and residualized IC analysis against the current factor library.
- Test whether the transition signal adds value specifically during stress-onset and stress-reversal episodes.
- Continue monitoring the weak early-regime performance and revalidate effective factors periodically.

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_2

### Explored Factors

1. **Dispersion-transition conditioned residual reversal**
   - Base signal: 10-day cross-sectional residual-return reversal, normalized by 40-day residual volatility.

   - Signal multiplier is bounded between 0.60 and 1.40.
   - Uses the 15 tradable benchmark assets and only completed historical observations.

| Horizon | Valid dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |

- Validation period: 2023-10-20 through 2035-04-11.

The factor passed both admission thresholds. Coverage was high and turnover was low. As with related reversal factors, performance was weak in the earliest regime but materially stronger in later regimes.

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_2

**Validation date:** 2035-05-24

### Explored Factors

1. **Multi-horizon residual trend**
   - Combined 20-day and 60-day cross-sectional residual momentum.
   - Volatility-normalized and bounded to `[-8, 8]`.
   - Tested across all 15 tradable instruments with at least 8 valid instruments per date.
   - Motivation: capture persistent cross-asset trends through agreement between medium- and long-horizon residual returns.

2. **20-day volatility-normalized residual reversal**
   - Signal: negative 20-day cumulative residual return divided by 60-day residual volatility.
   - Residual returns were calculated after subtracting the daily cross-sectional mean return.
   - Causal construction using only information available by each observation date.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Multi-horizon residual trend | 10d | 2,445 | 14.728 | 98.19% | -0.061355 | -0.211024 | 41.06% | 0.070592 |
| Residual reversal | 5d | 2,460 | 14.722 | 98.15% | 0.041209 | 0.140339 | 56.14% | — |
| **Residual reversal** | **10d** | **2,454** | **14.714** | **98.09%** | **0.048831** | **0.166523** | **56.64%** | **0.085043** |
| Residual reversal | 20d | 2,444 | 14.722 | 98.15% | 0.047059 | 0.162166 | 56.01% | — |

The residual trend factor failed to qualify because its predictive relationship was materially negative at the 10-day horizon.

The residual reversal factor passed both benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: `0.048831 ≥ 0.0070`
- Absolute ICIR: `0.166523 ≥ 0.0840`

Regime IC for the admitted 10-day horizon:

- 2024–2025: **-0.047643**, 156 dates
- 2026–2029: **0.056846**, 889 dates
- 2030–2032: **0.066684**, 784 dates
- 2033–2035: **0.037196**, 613 dates

The factor was negative in the earliest regime but positive and robust across the subsequent regimes. Results should be interpreted conservatively given the 15-instrument cross-section.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20350524_residual_reversal20_10d.json`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**
  - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20350524_residual_reversal20_signal.csv`

  - Includes validation metrics, coverage, turnover, decay diagnostics, regime results, thresholds, and provenance.
  - `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`; deterministic post-Miner correlation audit remains authoritative.

No live-account, backtest, or step actions were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly validated:

- **`miner_2_20350524_residual_reversal20_10d`**
  - 10-day IC: **0.048831**
  - 10-day ICIR: **0.166523**
  - Coverage: **98.09%**
  - Rank turnover: **0.085043**
  - Latest validation: **2035-05-24**

Previously persisted effective factors remain subject to the deterministic library-correlation audit and scheduled revalidation.

### Plans

- Compare the new 20-day reversal signal against existing reversal factors for incremental information content.
- Monitor its early-regime weakness and potential regime dependence.
- Explore orthogonal conditioning variables such as downside asymmetry, volume confirmation, and macro stress.
- Avoid persisting additional highly correlated reversal variants unless they demonstrate clear incremental value.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
frames={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=180: frames[s]=d.set_index('date')
# Range-location reversal: fade medium-term residual move, weighted toward assets
# whose recent closes sit near the lower/upper edge of their daily ranges.
C=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in frames.items()}).sort_index()
R=C.pct_change(); resid=R.sub(R.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
rev=-resid.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()/(resid.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(20)+1e-12)
high=pd.DataFrame({s:d.high.astype(float) for s,d in frames.items()}).reindex(C.index)
low=pd.DataFrame({s:d.low.astype(float) for s,d in frames.items()}).reindex(C.index)
# persistent close location: positive means closes near high; reversal signal fades it
loc=((C-low)/(high-low+1e-12)-0.5).rolling(10,min_periods=5).mean()
sig=(rev*(1-0.8*loc)).clip(-8,8)
print('assets',len(C.columns),'rows',len(C),'dates',C.index.min().date(),C.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fwd=C.shift(-h)/C-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   x=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if np.isfinite(x): vals.append(x); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
 a=np.array(vals); dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates); ns=np.array(ns)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'mean_n',round(ns.mean(),3),'coverage',round(ns.mean()/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),6))
 if h==10 and len(a):
  for x,y in [('2024-01-01','2025-12-31'),('2026-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2035-06-07')]:
   w=a[(dates>=x)&(dates<=y)]; print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)
  ranks=pd.DataFrame([sig.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in dates],index=dates)
  print('turnover',round(ranks.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))

## Research Cycle Summary — miner_2

**Validation date:** 2035-06-07

### Explored Factors

1. **Range-location conditioned residual reversal**
   - Base signal: 20-day cross-sectional residual reversal, normalized by 60-day residual volatility.
   - Conditioning variable: 10-day average close location within each asset’s daily high-low range.
   - Construction:
     - Subtract the daily cross-sectional mean return to obtain residual returns.
     - Negate the 20-day cumulative residual return.
     - Scale by trailing residual volatility.
     - Modulate by recent range location and clip to `[-8, 8]`.
   - Motivation: distinguish ordinary residual reversals from moves occurring near persistent range extremes.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments; dates with at least 8 valid instruments were included.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 2,467 | 11.936 | 79.57% | 0.046910 | 0.146257 | 56.22% |
| **10d** | **2,462** | **11.927** | **79.52%** | **0.051555** | **0.163231** | **55.97%** |
| 20d | 2,447 | 11.944 | 79.63% | 0.055622 | 0.176710 | 56.15% |

The 10-day horizon passed the benchmark admission gates:

- Absolute IC: `0.051555 ≥ 0.0070`
- Absolute ICIR: `0.163231 ≥ 0.0840`

Rank turnover was `0.087008`.

Regime-level 10-day IC:

- 2024–2025: `-0.052610`, 163 dates
- 2026–2029: `0.051496`, 889 dates
- 2030–2032: `0.084304`, 784 dates
- 2033–2035: `0.038623`, 623 dates

The factor was negative in the earliest available regime but positive in each subsequent regime. Coverage was below the typical 98% level because OHLC range data reduced valid observations; results should therefore be interpreted conservatively.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20350607_range_location_reversal_10d.json`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**
  - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20350607_range_location_reversal_signal.csv`
  - Validation script: `scripts/miner_2_20350607_range_location_reversal.py`
  - Includes IC, ICIR, decay, turnover, coverage, regime diagnostics, thresholds, and provenance.
  - `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null`; deterministic post-Miner correlation auditing remains authoritative.

### Current Effective Factors

Newly validated:

- **`miner_2_20350607_range_location_reversal_10d`**
  - 10-day IC: **0.051555**
  - 10-day ICIR: **0.163231**
  - Coverage: **79.52%**
  - Rank turnover: **0.087008**
  - Latest validation: **2035-06-07**

Previously persisted factors remain subject to library-correlation auditing and scheduled revalidation.

### Plans

- Compare this factor’s signal artifact against existing residual-reversal factors for incremental information.
- Monitor whether its lower coverage materially affects portfolio implementation.
- Explore additional OHLC-based conditioning variables, such as downside-range asymmetry and close-to-close efficiency.
- Avoid adding closely correlated reversal variants unless they demonstrate robust incremental predictive value.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
frames={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,3000)
 if d is not None and len(d)>=180: frames[s]=d.set_index('date')
C=pd.DataFrame({s:d.close.astype(float) for s,d in frames.items()}).sort_index()
R=C.pct_change(); resid=R.sub(R.mean(axis=1),axis=0)
# Causal residual 10d reversal, risk normalized; close-location shock emphasizes
# assets that have persistently closed at the adverse end of their recent ranges.
vol=resid.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()
base=-resid.rolling(10,min_periods=8).sum()/(vol*np.sqrt(10)+1e-12)
high=pd.DataFrame({s:d.high.astype(float) for s,d in frames.items()}).reindex(C.index)
low=pd.DataFrame({s:d.low.astype(float) for s,d in frames.items()}).reindex(C.index)
cl=((C-low)/(high-low+1e-12)-0.5)
loc=cl.rolling(15,min_periods=8).mean()
# contrarian location overlay; bounded for stability
sig=(base*(1-0.9*loc)).clip(-8,8)
print('assets',len(C.columns),'rows',len(C),'dates',C.index.min().date(),C.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 fwd=C.shift(-h)/C-1; vals=[]; dates=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in sig.index:
  z=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if np.isfinite(q): vals.append(q); dates.append(dt); ns.append(len(z))
 a=np.array(vals); dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(dates); ns=np.array(ns)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(a),'mean_n',round(ns.mean(),3),'coverage',round(ns.mean()/15,6),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((a>0).mean(),6))
 if h==10 and len(a):
  for x,y in [('2024-01-01','2025-12-31'),('2026-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-12-31'),('2033-01-01','2035-07-05')]:
   w=a[(dates>=x)&(dates<=y)]; print('regime',x,y,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)
  ranks=pd.DataFrame([sig.loc[d].rank(pct=True) for d in dates],index=dates)
  print('turnover',round(ranks.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
  pd.DataFrame([(dt,s,float(sig.loc[dt,s])) for dt in sig.index for s in sig.columns if pd.notna(sig.loc[dt,s])],columns=['date','symbol','factor_value']).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20350705_close_location_residual_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
